source_documents.title: Online Programs: Connecting a Pricing Plan to Your Program
source_documents.content:
Online Programs: Connecting a Pricing Plan to Your Program
You can monetize your program by linking it to a pricing plan. Offer different membership packages to encourage subscriptions. You can even enroll people when they buy the right plan. Already have existing plans, for apps like blogs, events, or groups? You can connect the same plans to your programs too. Finally, if a plan isn't relevant anymore, disconnect it.Before you begin:
Connect a payment method to get paid for your subscription plans.  Upgrade your site so people can start joining your program. DashboardWix app
Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard.
Tip: You can also link a pricing plan to your program using the Online Programs app. Choose what you want to do next:Connect a new pricing plan
Click + Create Plan. Create the relevant plan: 
    
Free plans: Offer your clients a free membership plan.  One-time payment: Create a one-time plan that lasts for the time period you choose.  Recurring payment: Create a subscription plan with recurring payments and select how often the plan and payment reoccurs: weekly, monthly, or yearly.    Connect and manage benefits for this plan:
    
Select the checkbox next to Online Programs. Click + Add Program under Programs Included and select the checkbox next to the program(s) you want to include in the pricing plan. (Optional) Select the Automatically add subscribers to these programs when they purchase this plan checkbox. This means people who purchase this pricing plan are automatically added to the program(s) you selected.   (Optional) Review the Plan preview to see how your plan will appear online. Click Save.Note: You can have up to 75 active pricing plans at the same time.Connect an existing pricing plan
Hover on the relevant plan and click Edit. Scroll down to Benefits.  Click + Add Program next to Online Programs. Select the program(s) you want to include in the pricing plan. (Optional) Select the Automatically add subscribers to these programs when they purchase this plan checkbox. This means people who purchase this pricing plan are automatically added to the program(s) you selected. Click Save.Disconnect a pricing plan from a program
Click Edit next to the relevant plan under Active plans. Scroll down to Benefits and click X next to the relevant program. Click Save.Note: 
Manually added members have access to your program regardless of pricing plans. If someone joins a program by buying a plan, they only have access as long as that plan is active. If you remove the plan, they lose access. They can get it back by renewing their plan.
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Pricing Plans under Catalog. 
Tip: You can also link a pricing plan to your program using the Online Programs app. Connect a new pricing plan:
    
Tap + Create New Plan. Create the relevant plan: 
        
Free plans: Offer your clients a free membership plan.  One-time payment: Create a one-time plan that lasts for the time period you choose.  Recurring payment: Create a subscription plan with recurring payments and select how often the plan and payment reoccurs: weekly, monthly, or yearly.    Connect benefits for this plan:
        
Tap + Connect Programs under Online Programs. Select the checkbox next to the program(s) you want to include in the pricing plan. Tap Done.   Tap Save.  Note: You can have up to 75 active pricing plans at the same time.Tip:Once you create a pricing plan, it is not currently possible to delete it. You can vote for this feature here. You can, however, hide or archive your plans as necessary to create new plans.

source_documents.title: Wix Video: Renting Your Videos
source_documents.content:
Wix Video: Renting Your Videos
You can set up your video settings to allow your viewers to watch them online. Viewers can watch online for a set price with a set amount of time to watch. Important:
Your site visitors need to sign up/become a site member in order to purchase videos, subscriptions, and also rent videos.  Video rental periods begin when your site visitors purchase them. Videos can only be rented for a maximum of 72 hours.  Social Media videos cannot be rented.  Videos set to rent cannot be downloaded. To Rent Your Videos:
Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Select the checkbox to the left of the video or videos that you want to rent. Click Set Pricing at the top of your list of videos. Select Paid. Select Video can be rented. Enter the price and length of the rental availability. Click Save.

source_documents.title: Time Required For Your Site to Appear in Search Engines (Google)
source_documents.content:
Time Required For Your Site to Appear in Search Engines (Google)
There is no guaranteed time frame in which your site will be indexed and appear in Google or other search engines. Wix guarantees that all of the text and meta tags on your site are scanned by search engines, however, it is the quality of your website that determines if and how you will rank. Read best practices for getting your site found on Google for more tips. Click here to check if your site has been indexed.You can speed up the time that it takes for your site to appear in search engine results by verifying your site:Verify your site ownership with Google Search ConsoleVerify your site ownership with Bing Webmaster ToolsOnce you have verified your site, you can submit your sitemap directly to Google via Google Search Console to make it easier for Google to crawl and categorize your site. Click here to learn more. Note:The waiting period for your site to be indexed is determined by the search engines themselves and is the same for all websites (not just Wix sites).

source_documents.title: Virus Protection on Wix
source_documents.content:
Virus Protection on Wix
The security of our users' accounts and sites is of extreme importance to us here at Wix and we are committed to online safety. If you believe you have found a virus on a Wix site please report it to: security-report@wix.com.

source_documents.title: Wix Bookings: Connecting Membership Plans and Packages Using the Wix App
source_documents.content:
Wix Bookings: Connecting Membership Plans and Packages Using the Wix App
Increase customer loyalty by offering your members membership plans and packages. Customers use memberships and packages in different ways, explained below:
Membership plans: Give unlimited access to selected services for a time frame you choose (For example, a yearly gym subscription).  Packages: Give members the option of buying a set number of services at a discounted rate (For example, a 10-classes-per-month package).Before you begin:
Create the Wix Bookings services you want to connect to your plans and packages. Learn how to: 
    
Create Appointments Create Classes
Note: Memberships and packages are currently not available for courses.   Create the membership plans or packages.In this article, learn more about:
Connecting pricing plans to booking services Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Connecting pricing plans to booking servicesConnect your pricing plans to your booking services while you're on the go, using the Wix app. You can connect specific plans to specific services as required. This is a great way to encourage more of your members to sign up for your pricing plans. To connect plans to booking services:
﻿Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap the Manage  icon. Tap Bookings Services. Tap the More Actions icon  next to the relevant service.
Tap Manage plans. Tap Connect under the relevant package or plan or tap + Create new plan.  Tap Done at the top right. FAQsWe are here to help with all your questions. Click a question below to learn more.What do clients see when they use their plan while booking a service on the Wix Member apps?When your clients select the session they want to book, they see the payment option to redeem from their package or membership plan. They also see how many sessions they have remaining as part of their package. If they have not purchased a plan yet, they see the option to buy a plan before continuing with booking the session. Can clients pay for group bookings using a package?Clients can pay for group bookings using their purchased packages on both desktop and in their member apps. Each participant in a group booking uses up 1 session in the package.

For example, if a client buys a 10-session package and makes a group booking with 2 friends using their package, it counts as 3 sessions used. They then have 7 sessions remaining. Can clients pay for group bookings using a membership?Clients cannot use their memberships to pay for group bookings.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Adding a Site Title
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Adding a Site Title
Add a site title to the top of your page to give your visitors a clear idea of what you, your site, or your brand is all about. Titles are a great way to grab your visitors' attention, and get them interested in exploring your site. In this article, learn more about:
Adding a site title How site titles can improve your siteAdding a site titleSite titles should be placed at the top of your site and have a larger font than the rest of the text found on your home page. This ensures that your visitors can clearly see it when they enter your site.Note:Adding a site title to your header means that it will appear on all pages.Show me how
Click Add Elements  on the left of the Editor. Click Text. Click Titles. Click and drag the text you want to use onto the top of your page or onto your header. Click the text in your Editor. Click Edit Text. Enter your site's title.Tip:Learn how to format your text to suit the look and feel of your site. Improving your site with titlesHaving a site title can enhance many aspects of your site, such as SEO and accessibility.As well as enhancing your site, it can also improve your visitors' experience by proving a clear summary of your site.  Click below to learn more about the benefits of having a clear site title.SEO benefitsHaving a clear site title that matches your URL means that when Google indexes your site, your site title will show up along with your web address.We recommend adding your site title as text, and making sure it's the same name as it is within your site's dashboard settings to ensure that Google indexes it correctly. Learn how to change your site's name on your dashboardAccessibility benefitsHaving a clear site title can help visitors with disabilities or impairments understand what your site is about. We recommend adding your site title as text, as well as defining the heading tags. This ensures that visitors using screen readers can navigate your site with ease. Learn how to define your text headingsReady to keep improving your site?Add unique title tags to each of your pages to enhance your site's SEO and Accessiblity. Learn how to add title tags to your site pages

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Publishing Your Site
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Publishing Your Site
Publishing your site that you created with the Wix Editor website builder is the final step in making it live. It's the moment where all your hard work in designing, creating, and refining your site pays off. Once you publish, your site is available on the internet for everyone to see. Don't have a site yet?Wix offers a variety of templates and design tools to help you create a professional-looking website in no time. Go to Wix.com and click Get Started to sign up and start creating.Learn more about:
Publishing your site Viewing your live site Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Publishing your siteYou can publish your site at any time from the top toolbar of the editor. Even after publishing, you can edit your site as much as you want. Whenever you make a change, simply publish again to make sure the changes go live.To publish your site:
Click Publish at the top right of the editor. (Optional) Click View Site to see your live site. Click Done to return to the editor.Note:Clicking Save won't make your changes live. After saving, make sure to click Publish to show the updates on your live site.Viewing your live siteAfter publishing your site, it automatically appears online and can be seen by anyone entering your free site URL (siteprefix.wixsite.com/site-name) or domain name.You can also access your live site from the editor. Click Site on the top bar of the editor and click View Site.If you want to show your site to your friends, you can email them your site URL or domain name, or share it on social media.FAQsClick a question below to learn more about publishing your site.Can I preview site my site before I publish it?Sure, you can preview your site anytime, before or after you publish. Click Preview at the top right of the editor to see how your site looks before publishing. I want to publish my site to see it online, but I don't want it to be public yet. How do I do this?If you're not ready to go public, you can publish your site but temporarily prevent search engines from indexing it. This way, you can share your site with friends and family without it appearing on Google. Why did I receive an error message when trying to publish?There are a few common reasons why you may receive error when trying to publish your site. Most are related to connectivity, or sign in issues. Learn more about these issues.How do I go back to a previous version after I have published my site? You can view and restore an older version of your site at any time. Learn more about your site history.I published my site accidentally, can I unpublish it?Yes, you can unpublish your site permanently or temporarily at any time. I published my site, why can't I find it on Google?New sites, pages, and updates may take some time to appear on search engine results, as they need to be crawled and indexed by Google. To check if search engines like Google and Bing have indexed your site, enter "site:" followed by the URL of your domain. For example, "site:mystunningwebsite.com/". Click here to learn moreTip: Optimize your site's SEO to get it found on search engines. Optimizing SEO may also improve your site's ranking on search result pages. Why doesn't my newly published site appear when I browse to my domain?Your site comes with a free Wix URL in the format siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress. If you connected your site to your own domain, it may take up to 48 hours for your site to appear when accessing to your domain on the Internet. Click here to learn more about your domain propagationI want to add a new page, but I don't want people to be able to see it yet. How can I do that?No problem. There are 2 ways you can prevent visitors from seeing a new page:
Hide the page from your site menu. Prevent search engines from indexing the page, so it doesn't show up in search results. This way, no one will be able to find the page unless you give them a direct link.Can I delete my site and start again?Yes, you can start again with a new site template at any time. If you upgraded your site, you'll need to reassign your plan to the new site before you delete it. Learn how to delete your site.
Note: You don't have to delete your site to start over from scratch, you can keep it in your account as a free Wix site, transfer it to a different account or unpublish it.Video tutorial
What's next?Make sure your site looks great on every screen size. Head over to the mobile editor to customize the mobile view. Click here to check it out

source_documents.title: Enterprise Solution: Managing all of Your Media Assets
source_documents.content:
Enterprise Solution: Managing all of Your Media Assets
Directly uploading images and videos to your Wix Studio for enterprise account is a convenient solution for efficiently managing your media assets across all of your sites. Whether your goal is to share a set of images or videos across various sites or quickly distribute new media assets to all your clients, uploading media to your Wix Studio for enterprise account can save you time and ensure consistency across your sites. When you upload your files, you can choose a category to add them to or add a new one to keep your files organized, e.g. sales, holidays, social media. Once you've uploaded a batch, you can notify your clients of the new media available for them to use. You and your clients can filter the media files by the categories you've created.Learn more about Wix Studio for enterprise or contact our sales team.In this article, learn more about:
Uploading your media files Managing categories for media files Archiving media filesUploading your media filesUpload images and videos directly to your Wix Studio for enterprise account to use across all of your sites. Choose a category for your media files, or add a new one, to keep your media assets organized and labeled. You can then filter your media assets by the categories you've created.Once you've uploaded a batch and want to share the news, click Notify Clients to notify your clients of the new media available for them to use in their sites. Your clients can also filter their media by the categories you've created.Tip:Learn more about supported file types and sizes for videos and images.To upload your media:
Go to Media in your enterprise dashboard. Click + Upload Files at the top right. Click Upload Files to select the files you want to upload. (Optional) Choose a category for your files, or click + Add New Category to add a new one. Click Upload.Managing categories for media filesEffortlessly manage your media file categories to maintain a well-organized digital library. By assigning files to specific categories or creating new ones, you can ensure easy navigation and quick access to your media assets. Enjoy full control by editing, deleting, or rearranging categories with easy hover and drag-and-drop actions. You can always add or remove categories to your media files.To manage categories:
Go to Media in your enterprise dashboard. Click Manage Categories. Click + Add New Category to add a new category for media files. Enter a category name and click the checkmark icon to save it.Tip:Hover over a category to edit or delete it. You can also drag and drop categories to rearrange their order.Archiving media filesWhen you're no longer using specific media files, but you still want to retain them for future use, archiving them is a great way to keep your library organized and reduce clutter.Note:You cannot delete media from the enterprise Media Manager, you can only delete media at a site level. Learn more about deleting media files from your media storage. To archive files:
Go to Media in your enterprise dashboard. Select the files you want to archive. Click Archive.Tip:To view your archived files, click the Archived tab. To unarchive files and have them available for use again, select the archived files and click Unarchive.

source_documents.title: Wix Groups Request: Allowing Members to Save Posts
source_documents.content:
Wix Groups Request: Allowing Members to Save Posts
Currently, it is not possible for group members to save group posts to a 'favorites' list. This feature would allow them easy access to posts later on.We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

source_documents.title: Wix Logo: Accessing the Wix Logo Maker
source_documents.content:
Wix Logo: Accessing the Wix Logo Maker
You can access the Wix Logo Maker with or without a website. Access the stand-alone Logo Maker to continue working with just your logo and additional designs. Or access the Logo Maker directly from your site's dashboard and manage your logo designs alongside your site. You can access all logos made within your account via your Logo and Brand page here. If you created your logo via the standalone dashboard, you will be directed to that relevant brand page. Alternatively, if you created your logo via a site dashboard, you'll be routed to that dashboard logo maker.Currently the Wix Logo Maker is not available in Wix Studio. To create a logo, you need to go to Logo & Brand in your site's dashboard and then upload the logo as an image in the Studio Editor.In this article, learn more about accessing the:
Stand-alone Logo Maker Logo Maker from your site's dashboard Logo Maker from your editor Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Accessing the stand-alone Logo MakerYou can create a full branding kit without a website from the stand-alone Logo Maker. Access the stand-alone Logo Maker here: wix.com/logo/maker.Opening the stand-alone Logo Maker takes you to the Brand Studio of the most recent brand you were working on. The Brand Studio houses all your brands and their designs in one place. You can navigate between your brands by clicking the My Brands drop-down.Accessing the Logo Maker in your dashboardAccess the Logo Maker directly from your dashboard and manage your branding without interruption.To access the Logo Maker in your dashboard:
Go to your site's dashboard. Click Site and App on the sidebar menu. Click Logo and Brand. Choose the option you'd like to take:
    
Create a design: 
        
Click Create New. Choose what you want to design: Logo, Business Card, Social Post or Printed Merchandise.   Edit an existing design: 
        
Hover over the relevant design under Latest Designs and click Edit.   Download a design: 

Hover over the relevant design under Latest Designs and click the More Actions icon . Click Download.    Accessing the Logo Maker in your editorWorking in your editor? You can access the logo maker with just a few clicks. Tip:If you have not purchased a logo, you can create one and utilize the 200x200 free sample file to display it on your site. If you need higher resolution logo files, you can purchase them by upgrading to any of the Logo plans.To access the Logo Maker in your editor:
Open your site in the editor. Click Add Elements  on the left menu. Click Image. Select Custom Logo. Click Add Logo.
Select the logo. Click Manage Brand. Add the relevant information, and select a design from the options available. Learn more about creating a logo with the Wix Logo MakerFAQsClick a question below to learn more about accessing the Wix Logo Maker:Can I create multiple brands in the Logo Maker in the dashboard?No. Currently, you can only create one brand per site in the dashboard Logo maker. If you want to create multiple brands, use the stand-alone Logo maker.Can I connect/disconnect an existing logo to any site in my Wix account?Yes, you can manage all of your logos by connecting or disconnecting logos as you need them.

source_documents.title: Wix Photo Albums: Setting Up Your Photo Albums Store
source_documents.content:
Wix Photo Albums: Setting Up Your Photo Albums Store
Important:
Wix Photo Albums Store is not available to all users. As of February 2023, it is no longer possible to add Wix Photo Albums Store to your site. As an alternative, you can add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your photos. To accept payments on your site, you'll need to have a Business & eCommerce Premium plan. Learn more about accepting payments.You can sell your digital or photo prints from your site with the Wix Photo Albums Store. Once you create an album, you can choose to sell digital and prints or digital images only:Sell Digital and Prints: Wix Photo Albums works with a third-party service, Order a Print to provide you with even more options when selling your printed photos. This is a great option to choose if you want to incorporate digital downloads and also a variety of canvases, mugs etc.Sell Digital Images Only: Visitors can purchase and download your image files directly from your site in just a few simple steps. Note: Wix automatically adds a watermark to your photos to protect them.Since the Wix Photo Albums Store is only available for new albums, if you already have an album, you'll need to create a new one to sell your photos.In this article, learn more about:
Setting up an Albums Store Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)Setting up an Albums StoreStart selling your digital and print images by setting up an Albums Store. You'll need to create a new album to sell your photos.To set up an Albums Store:
Go to the Photo Albums tab in your site's dashboard.  Click + New Album. Select an album cover style, then click Next. Select a layout for your album, then click Next. Add your business name or logo with one of these options:
    
Select Business Name and enter your business name in the text field. Select Logo and click Add Your Logo to add your logo.   Click Next. Enter a name for your album in the Album name field. (Optional) Enter some extra information about the album in the More info field.  Click Next. Click + Upload Media to add content to your new album. Click Create Album. Click Store on the left. Click Set Up Store. Choose what you want to sell:Digital Files and Prints
Select Digital Files & Prints. Click Next. Click OK. Click Change Currency to set your currency type.  Select the checkboxes next to the products you wish to sell.  Set pricing for your products:
    
For prints:

Hover over the relevant product and click Edit on the right. Set the desired value in the YOUR PROFIT field. (Optional) Select the Round Prices checkbox to round the retail price up to the nearest whole number.   For digital products:

Hover over the relevant product and click Edit on the right. Enable the toggle next to each license type you want to offer:
            
Standard License: Sell your images for personal, single use only. Extended License: Sell your images for commercial, multiple uses. Set the total allowed usage next to Number of Uses.   Set the price next to Retail Price.     Click Next. Enter your Business Information.  Click Next. Click the checkbox to complete the ownership confirmation. Click Done. Click Publish Now.Digital Files Only
Select Digital Files Only. Click Next. Click OK. Choose from the 2 types of licenses you want to sell:
    
﻿﻿Commercial Use: Content can be used for commercial use, in promotional campaigns such as advertising, as well as on websites and blogs. Permissions are for web and digital use only and does not require the owner to be credited. ﻿﻿Extended Use: This license offers images, illustrations and photos for commercial purposes. This license extends from web and digital to print use, and does not require the owner to be credited.   Choose the type of file format you want to sell and the price:
    
Web Ready: If you are uploading files over 1200px, we create a smaller version ideal for web use. This gives you two ways to sell. Web images should cost less than print. Set the price in the price field. Original File: Customers get the high-resolution file you uploaded, perfect for print and other outlets. Higher quality usually sells at a higher price. Set the price in the price field.   Click Next. (If necessary) Set up a payment method. Click the checkbox to complete the ownership confirmation. Click Done. Click Publish Now.Next steps:Once you've set up your store, you can view orders from the album's Store tab. FAQsClick a question below to learn more about setting up your Wix Photo Albums Store.Can I access images from the regular Media Manager when adding them to Photo Albums?Newly created Photo Albums that have the Store feature in them (whether it is active or not), have their own secured Media Manager. This means that it is not possible to access the images uploaded to the regular Media Manager when adding images to the Photo Albums with the Store feature.Can I add a Store to Photo Albums I created before the Photo Albums Store was launched?It is not possible to add a Store to the Photo Albums that were created before the Store feature was launched.Can I duplicate an Album and add a Store to it? Albums duplicated from the Albums without the Store feature in them do not have the option of adding the Store to them.Can I manage the Photo Albums Store in the Wix app?Currently, it is not possible to manage your Photo Albums Store in the Wix app on your mobile device. If this is a feature you would like to see in the future, please click Vote for this feature in this article and we'll make sure to keep you updated.Can I customize the purchase confirmation emails sent to customers who purchase from my Photo Albums store?It is not possible to customize the automated email customers receive confirming their purchase from your photo albums store. Additionally, custom automated emails are only able to be synced with Wix Stores purchases, not Photo Albums store.I've selected my desired license, where do my site visitors see these license terms?The selected license and associated terms display on the product page when your site visitors select their desired image and license. It is currently not possible to add these to the purchase confirmation email.

source_documents.title: Wix Restaurants: Creating Your Menus
source_documents.content:
Wix Restaurants: Creating Your Menus
Important:This article is about the original Wix Restaurants Menus App. Try out our new, improved menu app. Learn how to add and set up Wix Restaurants Menus (New) app.Display your restaurant's menus directly on your site. Create as many menus as you want (i.e. if you have separate Lunch and Dinner menus) and build sections into each menu to best showcase each dish. If you've enabled Online Ordering, customers can place their orders directly on your site after viewing your menus.
Connected Square POS to Wix Restaurants?If you have connected Square POS to your Wix Restaurant site, you need to manage your menus through Square.Want to learn more?Check out the course in Wix Learn on creating online menus.Step 1 | Create the menu sectionsEach menu is made up of sections and dishes. Before adding all your dishes, it's a good idea to decide which sections you need. For example, most restaurants have a Starters, Main Course and Dessert section. The default menu comes with 2 default sections. Select a section to edit it and make it yours.Don't want menu sections?If you don't want different sections in your menu, create a menu without a description and include only one section. Give that section a name that can serve as a description. Then, add all of your dishes to that one section.To create the menu sections:
Go to Menus in your site's dashboard. Click the default menu.  Click the section you want to edit. Click Edit next to Section Info at the top right. Edit your menu's section:
    
Image: Hover over the section image and click Add Image to change it.  Name: Enter a name for the menu section. Description: Enter a brief description of the menu section. Visibility: Select or deselect the checkbox to show or hide the section on your menu.   Click Save.Want to add more sections?Create as many menu sections as you need. Click + New Section, edit your new section and click Add. Step 2 | Add your dishesNow it's time to add your dishes to the menu. Start by editing the default menu items and then click Add Dish to add your own. To add your dishes:
Go to Menus in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant section. Do one of the following:
    
Edit an existing dish: 

Hover over one of the default dishes and click Edit.  Click Edit at the top right of Dish Info.   Add a new dish:

Click New Dish at the top.     Enter the dish info:
    
Image: Hover over Click to add an image and click the + icon to add an image to the dish. Name: Enter the name of the dish. Description: Describe the dish so that customers know what they're ordering. Price: Enter the price of the dish. Tax: For prices that don't already include tax, enter the tax percentage that should be added. Dish labels: Add labels to help customers identify key information about the dish (Vegan, Gluten Free, Spicy, etc.). Visibility: Select or deselect the checkbox to show or hide the section on your menu.   Click Save.Selections, extras and removing ingredients:Add even more options to your dishes in the Dish Options section. From here, you can add any of the following to your dishes:
Selection: Customers need to select a single option, such as the size of their pizza, or how well done their burger should be. Extras: Customers can select multiple options, such as toppings for a pizza. Deselection: Customers can remove ingredients from their order, such as onions from a salad.FAQsCan I reorder the sections on my menu?Yes. Reorder your menus, sections, and dishes at any time to best showcase your restaurant's menu and help diners find what they're looking for.To reorder your menu:
Go to Menus in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant menu, section or dish. Click the element and drag it to where you want it to be.How do I hide a section?Click the More Actions icon to the right of the relevant menu section to move it to another menu, hide or archive it.Can I delete a menu?If you no longer wish to use a menu, section or dish, you can archive and restore them at anytime. You can't permanently delete menus, sections or dishes.Can I use the same dish in different menus?Yes, you can add the same dish to multiple menus. This is useful if you have a dish that's available in multiple menus. For example, you might have the same Hamburger in both your Lunch and Dinner menus.To add an existing dish to a menu:
Select the relevant section. Hover over New Dish at the top right and click Select Existing. Select the dishes you want to add. Click Add.

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Managing Product Subscriptions
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Managing Product Subscriptions
Any time a customer purchases a product subscription from your online store, it appears in the Subscriptions tab in your site's dashboard. Important:To fulfill subscription orders (or cancel / refund a single order) go to the Orders tab. Learn how to fulfill a subscription.In this article, learn how to:
Update the shipping address Show customers how to update their payment method Temporarily suspend a subscription Cancel a subscription Add a grace period Change the date customers are chargedUpdating the shipping addressIf a customer moves or wants their subscription sent to another address, you can make that change in the Subscriptions tab. To update a customer's address:
Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Select the subscription you want to update. Click Edit Shipping Details on the bottom right. Update the address. Click Save.Showing customers how to update their payment methodCustomers can make changes to their credit card or other payment details by logging in to your site and selecting the My Subscriptions tab. They can then select the relevant subscription and click the Update Payment Method link. Temporarily suspending a product subscriptionYou can suspend a customer's subscription if they ask to stop it temporarily. New orders won't be created and your customer won't be billed until the suspension is lifted.Important:
Stripe: Some subscriptions created before September 19, 2022 cannot be suspended. Paypal: Some subscriptions created before June 22, 2022 cannot be suspended.To suspend a product subscription:
Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Select the subscription you want to update. Click Manage Subscription. Click Suspend subscription. Click Yes, Suspend.Reactivating a suspended subscription:When you're ready to reactivate the subscription, click Manage Subscription and then Reactivate Subscription.Canceling a subscriptionYou can cancel a customer's subscription at any time. When you do, no new orders connected to this subscription are created.Note:If you previously suspended a subscription and now want to cancel it, reactivate it first.  To cancel a product subscription:
Go to the Subscriptions tab in your site's dashboard. Select the subscription you want to update. Click Manage Subscription. Click Cancel subscription. Select Cancel now. Click Yes, Cancel.Want to learn more?Check out the full course in Wix Learn on building your store or skip to the video on selling product subscriptions.Adding a grace periodYou can set a grace period to allow your customers a little more time if their recurring payment fails. This lets them resubmit payment before their donation is canceled automatically.Learn how to set up a grace period.Changing the date customers are chargedBy default, subscription renewal dates are determined by the date of the original purchase. For example, if a customer orders a subscription on the 7th of January, a new order is created on the 7th of every month.  You can change the renewal date so that, for instance, the customer is charged on the 1st of every month. Learn how to change the payment date for your customers' subscriptions.

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Updating Inventory for PayPal eCheck Orders in Wix Stores
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Updating Inventory for PayPal eCheck Orders in Wix Stores
A PayPal eCheck allows customers to pay directly from their bank account. This article details the process and explains when to update your inventory when you receive an eCheck payment.The PayPal eCheck payment process:
When a customer makes a PayPal eCheck purchase, it appears in the Payments tab of your Wix dashboard with a 'Pending' status. Inventory is not updated at this stage as eCheck payments take between 3 to 5 working days to clear. Once the payment clears, you receive a notification, and the order appears in the Orders tab in the Wix dashboard as 'Completed'. At this point, the order's status in PayPal also updates automatically.When the process above is completed, update your inventory accordingly.For more information about handling eChecks, visit PayPal's help center.

source_documents.title: Wix Video: About Wix Video
source_documents.content:
Wix Video: About Wix Video
Engage your audience and monetize your content by showcasing your videos on your site. With Wix Video, you can upload your own content, or add videos from YouTube, Facebook and more. Your content can stand out on its own, or you can organize it into channels with personalized layouts.Start making money with your content by listing your videos for rent or purchase. You can also make whole channels accessible to subscribers only.Increase your video library spaceWhen you upgrade your site, your storage space increases. This gives you more room for growth and creates new opportunities for audience engagement. You can also choose to add a storage plan to your site to make sure you have enough space for your media. You can do this in addition to upgrading to a Premium plan.Learn more about upgrading your site's video storage.Engage your audience with videos from multiple channelsCapture your visitors' attention by displaying your video content on your site. You can choose from 6 layouts, each designed to showcase your video content in the best possible way.Upload videos to your library straight from your computer, or from other sites including YouTube, Facebook or Vimeo. You can organize your video content into channels, making it easier for you to manage, and for viewers to find the topics they're interested in.Learn more about adding and setting up Wix Video.Customize your video player to match your brandWhen you add Wix Video Player to your site, you're given the tools to customize the widget to your liking, and to match the look of your brand. You can also customize the layout, design, and functionality of your video player. Some of the customization options include:
Designing the font, shape and color of the text that appears on your player and thumbnails. Choosing a shape and color for buttons. Increasing or decreasing the opacity of background and cover images.Learn more about customizing the design of your site's video player.Start making money from your contentConnecting your video channel to a pricing plan allows you to start monetizing your content. You can give your viewers more choice by making multiple pricing plans available per channel, increasing the growth rate of your subscribers. You can make changes to your pricing plans at any time from your site's dashboard. Learn more about connecting a pricing plan to a video channel.Track your content's success with analyticsGain valuable insights into your content's engagement and visitors' behavior. You can find out what videos are performing the best, the devices your viewers watch your content on, and what channels generate the most subscriptions.See how many sales your videos attract over time by viewing reports that include statistics on video plays, shares, downloads and more.Learn more about video analytics and reports.

source_documents.title: ADI: Moving Your Site From ADI to Wix Editor
source_documents.content:
ADI: Moving Your Site From ADI to Wix Editor
ADI is a platform that aims to simplify your design process. We provide a variety of visual templates for every page or section, so you don't have to worry about your site looking professional.Creating a site on ADI but need more control and customization options? Switch to the Wix Editor, explore the features it offers and see if it's a better fit for your needs.Warning:If you move to the Wix Editor, you will not be able to return to ADI.Note:Currently, if you move to the Wix Editor, you will no longer be able to edit your site on a mobile or tablet device.Step 1 | Access ADI and Move to the EditorTo get started, access your site in ADI. You can switch to the Editor using the top bar (under Site), or click Go to Editor on the right. Show me how
Click Site on the top bar inside ADI. Select Go To Editor at the bottom. (In the pop-up) Click Switch to Editor.Step 2 | Explore the Wix EditorAfter clicking Switch to Editor, your site automatically moves to the Editor. Once the process is done, it's time to discover all the advanced tools and features it has to offer. Using drag and drop, you can start adding elements and apps to your site. Tell me moreOn the left side of the Editor, you can see the different menus that let you add new elements and apps to your site. You can also manage your pages, themes, media and much more.The options are displayed in the below order:
 Add panel: Add new elements and apps to your page using drag and drop.  Pages: Add new pages to your site and manage existing pages from here.  Theme Manager: View your site's color and text themes and adjust them as necessary.  Background: Change the current page's background. You can choose a color, an image or a video.   Add Apps: Add new apps to your site from the App Market.  Media: Upload media, edit images and videos and access your site's Media Manager.Tip:When switching to the Editor, the layout and design of your ADI site stay exactly the same – this allows you to continue building from where you left off.

source_documents.content:
Wix Bookings: Changing Languages
Some of the text that appears in Wix Bookings on your live site is text you wrote yourself (for example, the names and descriptions of your services). Other text is automatically generated, like the names of days and months in your calendar.You can change the language of the automatically generated text into any of over 25 languages.View the list of available languages for automatically generated textBahasa Bulgarian  Czech Danish Dutch EnglishFinnishFrench German Greek Hindi HebrewHungarian Italian Japanese Korean Norwegian PolishPortuguese Romanian Russian Spanish Swedish Tagalog Thai Traditional Chinese Turkish In this article, learn how to change the language of:
Your site's automatically generated text Your dashboard and EditorNote:We are in the process of releasing a new version of the Booking Calendar, so it's not available to everyone yet. Your version may appear slightly different.Changing the language of your site's automatically generated textMake sure the automatically generated text on your website, like the types of services you offer, is in the correct language for your clients. The site language, currency and regional settings you choose can make your client's experience feel much more local.To change the language of your site's automatically generated text:
Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Select a language from the Site language drop-down. (Optional) Choose a region from the Regional format drop-down. This controls how you show dates, numbers and measurementsTip:Changing your site language does not translate text you add to your site manually. If you would like to see this feature in future, you can click here to vote for it. Changing the language of your dashboard and EditorSet the language of your dashboard and Editor to one you're comfortable working with. This doesn't change the language clients see on your site. However, if you have more than one site, this change does affect the entire account. To change the language of your dashboard and Editor:
Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Account language and choose a language from the drop-down.Tip:You can also update your site language from your account panel at the top. Click the panel to open it, hover over the language at the bottom and choose your preferred language. 

Can't see your language in this list? Click here to vote for additional languages for Wix Bookings.

source_documents.content:
Connecting an Italian (.it) Domain to Your Wix Site
Once you upgrade your site with a plan, you can connect a .it domain you already own to your Wix site.Important:You will need access to your current domain registrar when you’re preparing to connect your domain.In most cases, we recommend connecting your domain to Wix via name servers.  With this connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records, which means you can manage them in your Wix account. This way, if you ever need assistance managing your DNS records, Wix Customer Care can help you.There is another connection method called pointing. However, it is not recommended as we're unable to assist you with some issues that may arise. Learn more about the differences between connecting your domain via name servers vs. pointing.FAQsClick a question below to learn more.How long can it take for my domain to be connected (propagate) to my Wix account? New DNS records can take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.Can I purchase a .it domain from Wix?Yes, you can choose to purchase a .it domain from Wix. Learn more about purchasing a domain from Wix.Can I transfer my .it domain to Wix instead of connecting it?No. This option is not currently available for .it domains.

source_documents.title: Different Amount Appearing on Your Wix Invoice and Bank Statement
source_documents.content:
Different Amount Appearing on Your Wix Invoice and Bank Statement
There are two main reasons why the amount listed on your bank statement might not match the amount on your Wix invoice.
The amounts are in different currencies: Depending on your location, the amount listed on your Wix invoice may be displayed in US dollars (for example, in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Argentina, Israel or Singapore). The amount you see on your bank statement will be in your local currency.  You have been charged bank fees: Your bank may charge additional processing fees for your payment. For example, a transaction fee or a currency conversion fee. 
Note: Bank fees or exchange rates are not determined or controlled by Wix.Still need help?Contact Wix Customer Care and we'll be happy to help.

source_documents.title: About Goods and Services Tax in Singapore
source_documents.content:
About Goods and Services Tax in Singapore
Wix charges Goods and Services Tax (GST) on our services to customers in Singapore in accordance with the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore. If you are a GST-registered business in Singapore, you may be eligible for a tax exemption. You can add your GST registration number to your Wix account by updating your payment details.Updating your payment detailsUpdate your payment details in your Wix account by adding your﻿ GST number to get your tax exemption.To update your payment details
Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon  next to the relevant subscription. Click Update payment method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next.  Click Edit Details.
Re-enter your card details and add your GST number to the GST Registration Number field.  Click Update. FAQsClick a question below to learn more about tax in Singapore.What is a GST number?A GST number is a tax ID issued to a business or person registered under the GST Act in Singapore. GST numbers can be checked at the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore’s website.What happens if I do not have a tax identification number?If you do not have a tax identification number, Wix will charge and collect GST on payments for subscriptions, applications and products.How does Wix determine which customers are subject to tax?The tax charge is based on the billing account address.

source_documents.title: Using an Authenticator App for 2-Step Verification for your Wix Account
source_documents.content:
Using an Authenticator App for 2-Step Verification for your Wix Account
2-Step verification is a security feature that lets you add another layer of verification to your login process. This helps prevent anyone else accessing your account without your knowledge. You can use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy to verify your identity every time you log in from an unrecognized device. In this article, learn more about:
How authenticator apps work Enabling 2-step verification with an authenticator app Signing in to your Wix account using an authenticator app Disabling 2-step verificationBefore you begin:We recommend that you set up your Recovery Phone Number before enabling 2-Step verification.How authenticator apps workAuthenticator apps generate a code that you can use in addition to your email and password to verify your identity. This code automatically regenerates at a set amount of time (e.g. every 30 seconds). The advantage of using an authenticator app instead of SMS or email verification is that it doesn't require an internet or mobile network connection. Using an authenticator app is also safer than SMS or email because the code is generated on your device instead of being sent to you. Some examples of popular authenticator apps are:
Google Authenticator (Android / iOS) Microsoft Authenticator (Android / iOS) Twilio Authy (Android / iOS) Duo Mobile (Android / iOS) LastPass Authenticator (Android / iOS)After you download and install an authenticator app to your mobile device, you can connect the app to your Wix account. The next time you try to sign in to your Wix account, you'll be asked to enter a 6-digit code from your authenticator app.Enabling 2-step verification with an authenticator appYou can enable 2-step authentication with an authenticator app in your Account Settings. Note:You can enable more than one verification option at the same time. If you choose to enable multiple options, the default prompt order is always: Wix mobile app first, then an authenticator app, followed by SMS, and then email.To enable an authenticator app:
Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to 2-Step verification. Click Enable next to Verify logins with an authenticator app. Enter your Wix password in the pop-up. Open your authenticator app.  Scan the QR code displayed in your browser with your authenticator app, or enter the code. 
Follow any additional steps in your authenticator app to add your Wix account to it. Click Next on the pop-up in your browser. Enter the 6-digit code that's shown in your authenticator app. 
Click Submit.Important:If you remove your account from your authentication app, or delete the app from your mobile device, you won't be able to sign in using this method. Signing in to your Wix account using an authenticator appWhen you sign in to your Wix account with 2-Step verification enabled, you need to confirm your login by adding a 6-digit code from your authenticator app. To sign-in with 2-step verification:
Sign in as normal on the Wix login page. Open your authenticator app on your phone. Get the 6-digit code for your Wix account.
Enter the 6-digit code under Enter code here on the Wix login page. 
Click Verify.Disabling 2-step verificationYou can disable your 2-Step verification at any time if you need to. After you disable it, you can log in without any additional codes. To disable 2-step verification:
Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to 2-Step verification. Click the drop-down and click Disable. Important:Disabling 2-Step verification means that your Wix account is protected only by your password.

source_documents.title: Wix Analytics: Understanding the Insights Page
source_documents.content:
Wix Analytics: Understanding the Insights Page
The Insights page in your site's dashboard can help you uncover key insights within your site data, empowering you to make impactful, well-informed business choices. Using this page, you can see the opportunities we've identified, general trends and potential areas of risk. You can find the Insights page under Analytics in your site's dashboard.

        View your Insights
    


        Take me there
      


Important:The insights on this page are based on visitor activity over the last 30 days. To see data on this page, your site must receive at least 50 visitors in the last 30 days.Explore different categories to make well-informed business decisionsThe Insights page is divided into distinct categories, for your convenience. Explore these tabs to gain further understanding of key data.  
Attention required: See what areas need your attention most at a glance. The Insights page gathers information and lets you know which areas need the most attention. For example, if your site sees a major decrease in traffic from Facebook, you might want to consider advertising on social media. Growth opportunities: Discover fresh opportunities to take your site to new heights. Insights identify opportunities across your site that you should note and capitalize on. For example, many site visitors might be visiting a specific product page in your online store. Consider adding an incentive to buy. Trends: Trends draw your attention to other things to take note of that don't appear in the other two categories. See changes in stats, and compare your site with others in the same category.Get personalized suggestions on how to improve your businessAlongside the insights on this page, you get tailored suggestions for your site, based on successful strategies used by similar sites. View suggestions about increasing traffic, sales and more.These data-driven recommendations are crafted with your business in mind. View offered suggestions by category or collectively and unlock your site's maximum potential with ease.Ready to get started? Visit the Insights page in your dashboard.

Click the Art Store in your Editor. Click the Store tab.  Click Set Pricing (available sizes can be viewed on the left).Tip:You can also set prices in this view. If you change any pricing in this view, make sure to click Done when you're finished.

source_documents.title: Logging in to Your Wix Account
source_documents.content:
Logging in to Your Wix Account
When you log in to your account at Wix.com, you can access your site's editor, manage your business from your site's dashboard, and more. 

        Click to log in to your account
    


        Log in now
      

Don't have a Wix account? Click Get Started on the Wix.com homepage to create one.Logging in to your Wix accountTo log in to your Wix account, you'll need the email address and password you used to create the account (or your current email address and password if you updated them). Alternatively, you can log in using SSO or your Facebook, Google, or Apple account.You need to use the same login method that you used when you initially signed up.To log in to your Wix account:
Go to Wix.com. Click Log In at the top right. Choose your login method:Email and password
Enter the email address associated with your account. Click Continue with Email. Enter your password in the Password field. Click Log In.Tip: Forgot which email address you used? Use our Find your login email tool to locate your account.Social login (Google/Facebook/Apple)
Click the relevant social account.
 Follow the on-screen instructions.Tip: You can choose which social accounts you want to log in with from your Account Settings. Learn how to manage social loginsSingle Sign-On (SSO)Single Sign-On (SSO) is an authentication method that lets users in an organization log in to different websites using the same set of login details.Logging in with SSO is only available to certain users. If you think that you should be able to sign in using SSO, contact your organization's IT administrator.
Troubleshooting login issuesClick the issue you're experiencing below to learn how to resolve it. I forgot my passwordIf you can't log in to your Wix account because you've forgotten your password, you can get a reset link sent to your email address. From there, you can create a new password to sign in to your Wix account.
Enter your email address and click Continue with Email.
Note: If you're not sure which email address you used, try our email locator. Click Forgot Password?.
Learn more about getting a password reset linkI forgot my email addressIf you can't remember the email address that you used to create your Wix account, you can recover your account in 2 ways:
Use our email locator tool: If you're not sure of your Wix account's email address, you can use our email locator tool to find the correct login email.  Use your recovery phone number: If you have a recovery phone number added, you can recover your account using your phone. I lost access to my email addressIf you've lost access to the email address that you used to create your Wix account, you can recover your account in 2 ways:
Get an SMS code: If you added a recovery phone number in your Wix account, you can get a one-time SMS code sent to your mobile phone to access your account. Submit an ownership verification form: If you haven't added a recovery phone number, you can fill out our ownership verification form to confirm that you are the genuine account owner. I can't log in with my Google accountThe Google sign in option opens a new window where you can sign in to your Google account. Make sure that your browser isn't blocking cookies or popups which may prevent this window from opening (for example, if you're using an adblocker or popup blocker). If you're already signed into your Google account, make sure it's the same account you used to sign up to Wix. You can sign out of your Google account at google.com before signing in to your Wix account again. If you have third-party cookies disabled in your browser, you may have difficulties trying to log in with your Google account. Follow the steps below for your browser to enable third-party cookies.
Google Chrome Safari for Mac Microsoft Edge FirefoxNote: If you don't want to enable third-party cookies, you can log in with your email address and password instead.I can't find my site after I log inIf you can't find the site you're looking for on the Sites page, check that you are logged into the correct account. Use the Account Email Locator to check which email address that you used when creating your site.
Go to the Account Email Locator. Enter your site's URL. Click Next.You'll find the email address associated with your account under Your Wix account email is. If you know your password, click Log In, if not, click Reset Password.Learn more about logging in to the correct accountI can't access my phone (2-step verification)If you have enabled 2-step verification by email, you can click Send code by email to receive a code to your email address instead. Learn more about verifying your account by email. If you haven't enabled 2-step verification by email, please fill out the ownership verification form and our team will be able to help.  I didn't receive an SMS codeIf you don't receive an SMS, you can click Call me to get a phone call from Wix and listen to the verification code instead.I'm asked to enter a number from a pictureWix uses Google's reCAPTCHA tool to help protect against potential spam and other types of automated abuse.reCAPTCHA asks users to enter numbers or words seen in distorted images. reCAPTCHA is simply a test to tell humans and robots apart.You must type exactly what you see in the reCAPTCHA image, whether it's a number, a word, or several words. When you are done, press the enter key on your keyboard. Tip: You can click the audio button to listen to an audio reCAPTCHA option. The set of numbers is read out and you must enter the numbers you hear in the provided space. When you are done, press the enter key on your keyboard. Learn more about reCAPTCHA and the Wix login processThe login page isn't loadingTry opening Wix.com in an incognito window or private browsing mode. Learn how to use  private browsing mode for your web browser. You can also try clearing your browser's cache if you're experiencing issues with the login page. My site is managed by someone else and I can't log inIf you don't have access to your login email, or you need help recovering access to your account, we recommend contacting the site owner. They'll be able to send you a new invite to access the site. My bookmark link to the login page doesn't workIf a bookmark link to the Wix login page that you previously used no longer works, the link may have expired. Follow the steps below to fix this issue.
Delete the bookmark that's causing the issue. Go to Wix.com. Click Log In at the top right. Log in to your account.  Create a new bookmark. FAQsClick a question below to learn more.Can I change the email address associated with my Wix account?Yes, you can change the email address associated with your Wix account from your Account Settings. Make sure to use the new email address when logging in.How do I enable or disable two-step verification?You can enable or disable two-step verification from your Account Settings. This adds an extra layer of security to your account.How do I log out of my Wix account?To log out, click on your profile picture at the top right corner of your site's dashboard and select "Log Out."What should I do if I suspect unauthorized access to my account?If you suspect unauthorized access, change your password immediately and enable two-step verification. Contact Wix Customer Care for further assistance.
