source_documents.title: Wix Bookings: Creating a Class
source_documents.content:
Wix Bookings: Creating a Class
Classes are recurring services that clients can book without committing to attend every session. The service can be a weekly Zumba class, for example, or a daily beginner yoga class.Start by creating the class and then schedule it as often as you like. You decide when and how often you offer a class, and how long the class lasts.Tip:Wix Bookings offers three different types of services - classes, courses and appointments. Make sure you choose the right type of service for your business.Check out the full course in Wix Learn about adding classes and courses to your site to build your business. Step 1 | Create a classStart by creating the class and adding the necessary information. Make sure to include specifics about what clients can expect from the class. For example, images showcasing the class experience.Before saving, you can review what your clients see before they book their class in the Overview section.To create a class:
Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click + Add a New Service in the top right. Under Class, choose what you want to do:  
    
Click Edit below the relevant class template. Click + Start from Scratch to use a blank template.    Fill out the Service details:
    
Name: Enter a name for the class.  Tagline (optional): Enter a tagline that will appear below the class name on your site. Description (optional): Enter a description that will appear on the service page of your site. Tip: Click Generate AI Description to let AI (Artificial Intelligence) help you create a description.  Image (optional): Add an image for clients to see when they look through your list of classes. Max participants: Enter the maximum participants for each class.  Step 2 | Set the price and payment options for your classOnce you add the basic information about the class, you can then choose from several pricing and payment options. Offering more options can help boost your sales.To set the price and payment options for your class:
Scroll down to the Price & Payment section.  Select the relevant option under Choose how clients can pay for this service:

Per session: Clients pay for sessions based on the price you set. With a plan: Clients pay using one of your memberships or packages.  Per session or with a plan: Clients pay either per session or with a membership or package.    Depending on the payment method you chose, follow the steps to set it up:Per sessionSelect the relevant pricing option from the Price type drop-down:
Fixed price: A set amount you choose:
    
Enter the price under Amount. Choose how clients pay you under Payment preferences (e.g. entire amount online, online deposit, etc.)    Free: Offer this class for free.  Varied prices: Create different price options depending on the client type.
    
Enter the Default price for this class. Click + Add Price Options or Manage Price Options to edit your existing price options. Set the pricing:
        
In the Price options label field, enter the text that clients will see above the price options. Enter the option name and set the price next to it. Repeat this step for each different price option you want to create.
Tip: Click + Add New Price Option to add another option.   Click Save.   Choose how clients pay under Payment preferences (e.g. entire amount online, online deposit, etc.)    Custom price: Enter a description of how you charge for classes. For example, "Starting from $25."With a planClick an option to connect this class to a membership plan or package:
Connect an Existing Plan: Enable the toggle(s) next to existing plans you want to connect. Then click Done.   Create New Plan: Create a new package or membership plan.Per session or with a planThis option allows your clients to choose how to pay for the class. They can use a pricing plan they've purchased, or pay the price you set per session. 
Set the Price per session. Connect the relevant pricing plan(s) under Memberships & Packages. 
Tip: See Per session or With a plan above for detailed steps. Step 3 | Setting your class locationDisplay where you offer the class, for example, at your business location(s) or choose a custom location somewhere else. You can also add the option to meet online with a video link. To set your class location:
Scroll down to the Location section. Click Edit to choose where your service is provided:
    
Business location: Click the checkboxes next to the business location(s) that will have this service available.
Tip: Learn more about adding additional locations. Custom location: Choose a custom location (e.g. online meeting).   Click Save.  (Optional) Enable the Video Conferencing toggle to offer the class online.
Note: If this is your first online service, click Add. Then, select Zoom or a custom link and click Continue.Step 4 | Set your class timesNow you can set the class times and add specific details for different days of the week. Add the instructor, individual class durations depending on the day of the week, and the start and end dates for the class term. Tip:You can create one-time services that start on a specific day and run for several days in a row. This is perfect for multi-day seminars, workshops, guided tours, and more.To set your class times:
Click Add Sessions under Schedule.  Edit the relevant details:
    
Location: Select where the class takes place from the drop-down.
Note: This is useful if you run the class in different places during the week. Staff: Select the relevant staff member from the drop-down. Start Time: Choose the date and time that the first session begins. Duration: Select the class session length from the Duration drop-down.
Tip: To create a multi-day service, select Custom from the drop-down and set the session duration to cover multiple days (up to 99 hours). Repeat: Select how frequently you offer the class from the Repeat drop-down.
Tip: To create a session that doesn't repeat, schedule a class through your Booking Calendar. (Optional) Set an end date: Choose a date when these sessions end.   Click and choose a saving option:
    
Save & Add New: Save and schedule the same class at a different time, day, location or with a different staff member.   Save: Save the schedule and return to editing the class.   Step 5 | Add images to your classAdd a cover image and an image gallery to show clients what your class is all about. The cover image appears at the top of the service page, and the gallery appears next to the information about your class.  To add images to your class:
Scroll down and click Images. Add images to your class by doing the following:
    
Add Cover image: Select an image for the background of your service's header. Add Service gallery: Add more high quality images to a gallery for your service page. You can customize the gallery's layout and design in your editor.    (Optional) Click + Add alt text to add alt text to your images that describes them for search engines and screen readers. Step 6 | Customize your class with Booking preferencesFurther customize your new class in the Booking preferences section. Add a customized booking policy for the class or make the class view-only to generate interest in upcoming services. Create a custom booking form for the class if you need more information from clients before they attend. You can allow members to skip the booking form for a quicker booking experience on the member apps.Note:Clients cannot skip the booking form if the class service has different price options, allows multiple participants in a single booking (group bookings), or if their required personal details, such as name and number, are missing.To customize your class with Booking preferences:
Scroll down and click Booking preferences. Select a Booking policy from the drop-down or choose what you want to do:
    
Add new policy: Click + Add New Policy to create a new booking policy. Edit policy: Click Edit policy to make changes to an existing booking policy.    Enable the Online bookings toggle to allow clients to book classes online:
Note: Disable the Online bookings toggle to make the class view-only.
    
Choose which Booking form you want to use from the drop-down:
        
Custom form: Click Custom booking form to create a new booking form for this service. Edit form: Click Edit Form to make any changes to your booking form.    (Optional) Click the Skip this form when clients book on a Wix mobile members app checkbox to give your clients a faster booking experience on the app.   Click Save. Want to learn more?Check out the full course in Wix Learn about adding classes and courses to your site to build your business. FAQsClick a question below to learn more about creating and managing classes.How can I edit an existing class's details?You can edit or cancel a class at any time in the Booking calendar. You can edit the details of a single session or all future sessions of the class.How can clients book a class with a single tap on the member apps?To enable single tap bookings on the member apps, select the Skip this form when clients book on a Wix mobile members app checkbox in your Booking preferences.Note: Single-tap booking is only available after the client's first booking.Single tap booking will not be available and clients will need to complete the booking form if:
The class has different price options. Group bookings (multiple participants in a single booking) are allowed. Required personal details, like name and number, are missing.What do my clients see when a class is fully booked?When clients attempt to book a class that is full, they see two different buttons depending on your settings. If you enable waitlists for classes, clients can click Join Waitlist.
Note: Clients can join the waitlist only through a Wix members app. When they try booking from your website, they'll be prompted to download the app.

If you don't enable waitlists for your classes, clients can click Check Next Availability to book into the next upcoming class session.You can edit the text which appears on your booking calendar, including on the next available button, in your site editor.Which factors affect the way available classes appear in my Booking Calendar?The times you choose when creating a class and your booking window affect the way available classes appear in your Booking Calendar.Do other services scheduled at the same time as my class affect the available classes in my Booking Calendar?No, other services scheduled at the same time as a class do not affect the availability of classes on your Booking Calendar. The available classes are also not affected by:
Time blocked manually in your Bookings Calendar. Events synced from you or your staff members' Google calendars. How can I create a multi-day class?To make multi-day class:
Follow the steps in the section to create a class. Click Add Sessions under the Schedule section.  Click the Duration drop-down and select Custom. Set the session duration to cover multiple days (up to 99 hours). Click Save. Click Save to save the class.Tips: 
Make sure to edit the hours for the staff providing this service so they are available 24 hours a day on the relevant days.  To run a similar service in future that starts on another date, simply duplicate the event you created and set a new start date.

source_documents.title: Updating Your Payment Details in Wix for Failed or Declined Renewal Payments
source_documents.content:
Updating Your Payment Details in Wix for Failed or Declined Renewal Payments
If a renewal payment fails or is declined, you can update your payment method to a credit or debit card. There is an Update Payment Method notice on the relevant subscription in the Premium Subscriptions section of your account. Reasons for failed or declined renewal paymentsThe payment may have failed due to one of the following reasons:If you are using a card payment: 
The payment has been declined by your card payment provider The payment card provided has expired or has insufficient funds The payment card number provided is invalid The payment card provided has not been approved for recurring paymentsTo resolve the payment issue, please update to another card.  You can contact your bank to find out why the payment failed. If you are using PayPal online payment service:
The payment method has been declined by your service provider, PayPal. You can contact PayPal to find out why the payment failed. If you do not wish to enter card details on your Wix account, you may need to update your preferred payment method in your PayPal account in order for this payment method to function again.Alternatively, you can update your payment details in your Wix account to a card, instead of PayPal.Updating your payment methodYou can add a debit or credit card to your Wix account if your current payment method (card or online payment service) is declined.To update your payment method: 
Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click Update Payment Method under the relevant subscription. Update your payment card details. Click Submit.
Note: Once you have updated your payment details, our system attempts to process the payment again.Tips:
You can also update your payment method in the Payment Methods page in your Wix account. If you are updating your Wix account payment method, you can update it to a debit / credit card, or PayPal if that option is available in your region.

source_documents.title: Using AI to Create an Online Store
source_documents.content:
Using AI to Create an Online Store
Harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to build and manage your online store with Wix Stores. By utilizing AI, you not only save time and effort, but also ensure a more seamless and efficient operation of your store. Think of it as having a smart assistant who can handle multiple tasks accurately and quickly. AI can be used in various aspects of your store, from creating your products to promotion, leaving you more time to focus on other aspects of your business.Get inspiration for your store from other websites built with Wix Stores.Get a ready-made site for your storeWith Wix's AI website builder, you have a simple and intuitive way to build your online store. This tool interacts with you via a chat and gathers your website requirements through a series of questions. It considers your design style preferences and the functionalities you need for your store, then generates a customized site tailored to your needs.Feel free to request changes to parts of your site or ask the assistant to create a completely new one. Once it's ready, you can customize all parts of your site using the Wix Editor.Ready to build your site?Take me to the Wix AI website builder.Write product descriptionsUsing Wix's AI, you can quickly create product descriptions for your online store. When creating your product, just enter your product name and its key details. AI will then generate 3 different descriptions for you. You can pick the one you like best and make any changes you want. Try it out and save yourself some time and effort.Learn how to start creating your store products.Create and edit product imagesWhen setting up your online store, one of the most crucial aspects is creating captivating product images. They're the first thing your customers see, and first impressions count in the online marketplace. With the help of Wix's AI tools, creating stunning product images has never been easier.Click Crop & edit image on your product image to access the Wix Photo Studio.Once there, you will find several AI tools to enhance your image:
Auto enhance: Automatically enhance your images to give your product photos a professional look. Remove and change backgrounds: Use AI to remove the background and place your product against a different backdrop.  Improve image quality: Use the Upscale Image tool to increase the resolution of your photos, making them look sharp and clear even on larger screens. Change parts of your image: Use the AI Image Editor to select parts of your image and use AI to change it to whatever you want. Remove parts of the image: Use the Object Eraser tool to remove any unwanted objects from your photos. Want to create a new image for your store?Use the AI Image Creator to generate images based on a description of your product.Generate marketing emailsUsing AI to create email campaigns for your online store is a simple and efficient process, and you need absolutely no marketing experience. First, decide on the intent of your email. This could be anything from offering a discount to promoting a sale. Next, enter your key business details. This includes information like your store's name, the products or services you offer, and any other relevant information for your email campaign.Once you've entered all of this information, AI will take over. It will generate a full, detailed marketing email for you, complete with images, text, and links to your store. This email will be tailored to your business and the intent you chose, making it a powerful tool for driving sales and engaging with your customers, with hardly any effort on your end.Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard to get started.Improve your store's SEOSo, you're not an SEO expert? No need to worry. Use Wix's AI tool for SEO to help you write the title tags and meta descriptions for your site's pages and products. This can help your online store's ranking on Google and may help customers find your products more easily.Important:This feature is only visible once you upgrade your site.The AI text generator will suggest 3 optimized suggestions for title tags and meta descriptions based on your existing page content. You can refine and recreate these suggestions to get more personalized results or change the tone of voice to match your brand.Go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) in your site's dashboard to set up your store's SEO using AI.

source_documents.title: Wix Bookings: Adding Your Business and Regional Details
source_documents.content:
Wix Bookings: Adding Your Business and Regional Details
When using Wix Bookings, it's important that you add your business and regional details to help your clients find you with ease, both physically and online. It's crucial to keep these settings in your site's dashboard updated. When you specify your currency, language, and time zone, these details are what your clients see on your site.By doing this, you're making it easier for your clients to interact with your business. If you're a yoga instructor in New York, for example, setting your currency to USD, your language to English, and your time zone to Eastern Time ensures your local and international clients can book your classes without any confusion. It creates a smooth, hassle-free booking experience for your clients.
Step 1 | Add your basic infoStart by adding your basic site information. This can include your site name, the site address attached to your domain and your Facebook username. To add your basic information:
Go to your site's Settings.  Click Website Settings. Check your site name is correct, in the Site Name section.  Do any of the following to update the information about your site:
    
Site Address (URL): If your site has a domain, check the URL is correct.  Favicon image: Upload an image to appear on web browser tabs next to your site name.  Social image: Upload an image to appear alongside your site URL when shared on social media sites like Twitter and Facebook.  Facebook username: Enter the Facebook username you want to link to your site.
Note: Facebook uses this username to verify likes you get on your website.    Click Save. Step 2 | Add your business infoNext, add your business details that people see on search results, invoices, chats and more. Include all business addresses and set your default hours so clients know where and when they can reach you. You can also improve your branding by adding a logo and a short description of your business. Note:Make sure to set your business address to the same country by selecting the correct business address from the drop-down. If you type the address but don't select it from the drop-down, it may not save correctly. If the business address is empty or not in the same country, the correct tax rates won't appear. To add your business info:
Go to your site's General Settings. Click Business Info. Enter your Business Name.  Enter your business Category so you show up in the right search results. 
    
(Optional) Enter a short description of your business and the kinds of services you offer.  (Optional) Upload an existing logo or create one using the Wix Logo Maker.    Add your primary business address.



(Optional) Add an address description if additional directions are required.  (Optional) Click + Add New Location at the bottom of the page if your business has multiple locations.   Add your contact information such as your number and email address to your primary business address.  Click Apply.  Click Save. Step 3 | Set your language and region detailsYour language and region details help Wix Bookings to determine a number of your site settings, including the first calendar day in your bookings calendar.To set your language and region details:
Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Click the Site Language drop-down to set your site's default language. Click the Regional format drop-down to set your site's region. This ensures that dates and numbers appear in the format of the region you choose. Click the Currency drop-down to set the currency you get paid with. This also sets the currency visitors see on your site. Click the Time zone drop-down to set both your site's time zone and the time zone of your business location. Click the Account Language drop-down to set your account language - this doesn't affect the language people see on your site.Tips:
You can set which time zone you display on your site or let clients choose which time zone they prefer to see.  Make sure to set the correct time zone so that your site functions properly. You can check this in the Formats preview window. What's next?Once you set up your site's basic business and contact information, you may want to add personnel with specific duties. Learn more about setting staff permissions.

source_documents.title: Wix Media: Adding and Setting Up the Right Click Protect App
source_documents.content:
Wix Media: Adding and Setting Up the Right Click Protect App
Protect your site from right-click downloads with a custom copyright notice. This is a great option if you want to prevent visitors from downloading images from your site or copying your text.When a customer right-clicks a protected element on your site (e.g. an image or text) they see a copyright message which you can customize.In this article, learn more about:
Adding the app Customizing your copyright message Changing your message design Deleting the app Important InformationAdding the Right Click Protect appYou can add the Right Click Protect app to your site from the Wix App Market. Wix EditorStudio Editor
Click Add Apps   on the left side of the editor. Search for the Right Click Protect app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.
Click App Market  on the left side of the editor. Search for the Right Click Protect app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.Customizing your copyright messageCustomize your copyright message and add copyright symbol(s).To edit the app's settings:
Click the app in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Settings tab. Edit the message users see when they right-click your text or images (e.g. Copyright Protected). (Optional) Click the copyright symbol you like best to add it to your message.Changing your message designAdjust the theme, font, and color of your copyright message.To customize the app's design:
Click the app in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Design tab. Click the Font icon  and customize the font's style:
    
Themes: Click the drop-down to choose a preset or customized theme for your text. Fonts: Click the drop-down to select your message's font. Font size: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the text size (between 12 and 60 pixels).   Click the Color Box to select a color for your message. Drag the slider to change its opacity.Deleting the appYou can delete the app from your site at anytime.To delete the app:
Select the app in your editor. Click Delete on your keyboard or right click and select Delete. Publish your site to save the changes.Important informationPlease read through the following important information regarding the Right Click Protect app:
Currently, it is not possible to choose which site pages are protected with the Right Click Protect app. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for that feature. The Right Click Protect app's message is visible on your mobile site, however, right-click download protection itself is currently not supported on mobile devices. If you have added the app more than once to your site, you will need to delete each instance of it separately. This app does not provide 100% protection as visitors can still use the print screen function to copy an image, or access the images through your site's source code (if they know how). The app does not protect against left click, meaning that visitors can highlight text and then use ctrl + C to copy. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for that feature. This app does not provide protection for third-party apps, embedded HTML content, embedded websites, or the Wix Stores product gallery.

source_documents.title: Wix Member Apps: Adding Bookings Widgets on the Wix Member Apps
source_documents.content:
Wix Member Apps: Adding Bookings Widgets on the Wix Member Apps
Include widgets on your Wix Member Apps to show your content and what you offer. To help manage your schedule, you can add upcoming bookings, agenda, services, and upcoming sessions widgets to your app.Once you've added these elements, choose where to display them, and manage, edit, or remove them for a personalized experience. Place the elements where members can clearly see and interact with them.In this article, learn more about:
Display your Bookings widgets Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Displaying your Bookings widgetsSelect the Booking widgets you want to include on your member apps and customize them to your liking. Rename widgets, select which screens in your member apps to display them on, choose which devices are able to see these elements, and more. To display your Bookings widgets:
Go to your site in the Wix App. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Site & App. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.  
Note: If you haven't set up the Member App your members will use, tap the drop-down under Mobile Apps then choose your preferred members app. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and choose the screen in which you want to place the widget.  Tap + Add Element.  Tap Bookings at the top.  Tap the element you want to add:Upcoming bookingsRemind clients of their upcoming bookings, allow them to easily book a new appointment and see their booking history.
Edit the following details:
    
Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use. Show avatar preview: Enable the Show avatar preview toggle to show avatars of participants who have booked the sessions already. Empty state text: Add a message for clients who have no upcoming sessions booked.  Online sessions: Choose a layout for virtual sessions: With image or Text only. Booking history: Enable the Booking history toggle to show previously booked classes and appointments so members can quickly book again.  Visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: All, Android, or  iOS.    Tap Add at the top right. Agenda (Weekly timetable)Add a weekly timetable and make it easier for your clients to find and book the right service. 
Edit the following details:
    
Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use. Element visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: Android devices, iOS, or All.    Tap Add at the top right.ServicesA list of all your services where your clients can book services straight from the screen. Clients can also filter services by location.
Edit the following details:
    
Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use. Element visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: Android devices, iOS, or All.    Tap Add at the top right. Upcoming sessionsA preview of upcoming sessions.
Edit the following details:
    
Element title: Enable the Element title toggle to show a title at the top of the element. Then enter the text you want to use. Element visibility: Choose which devices you want to show these elements: Android devices, iOS, or All.    Tap Add at the top right.FAQsClick a question below to learn more.Can I move widgets from one screen to another?Yes. Once you add a widget, you can move it to another screen. Here's how:
Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element. Tap Customize element. Tap the Choose screen drop-down under Location and select which screen you want the element to appear on. Tap Save at the top right.How do I customize an existing widget?To customize an existing widget:
Tap Manage  at the bottom of your screen. Tap Site & App. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.   Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of an existing element. Tap Customize element. Edit the element and tap Save at the top right.Can I delete a widget?Yes. Once you delete a widget, you are still able to add the same element again, but any customizations made will need to be reapplied.
Go to your site in the Wix App. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Site & App. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.  Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element. Tap Delete element. Tap Delete element to confirm.How do I add the same widget to two different screens?You can duplicate a widget, then move the duplicate widget to another screen. To add the same widget to two screens:
Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Site & App. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.  Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element. Tap Duplicate. Tap Edit icon   at the top right of the duplicated element. Tap Customize element. Tap the Choose screen drop-down under Location and select which screen you want the element to appear on. Tap Save at the top right.How can I change the order of my widgets?You can move your widgets up or down in the screen to organize them.To reorder your widgets:
Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Site & App. Tap Customize under Mobile Apps.  Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and select the relevant screen. Tap the Edit icon   at the top right of the element. Tap the relevant option: Move up or Move down.Can clients filter what they see on widgets?Yes. In their Member App (Fit by Wix or the Spaces App), on the Agenda page or the Weekly Timetable, clients can click Filters to view sessions by location, service or staff member.

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Setting Up Real Time Shipping Calculation with USPS
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Setting Up Real Time Shipping Calculation with USPS
Important:We're in the process of rolling out new shipping settings. If you have a Create Region button instead of Add Region, then you have the new version. Learn how to set up shipping using the new settings.Real Time Shipping Calculation allows you to charge customers a more accurate rate for shipping.How do real time shipping calculations work?
The USPS calculator provides approximate, dynamically-calculated shipping rates based on the weight and dimensions of the order, and on the shipping cost to and from addresses. Is this an estimate or the actual shipping price?
The price is a close estimate, however, actual shipping costs may vary based on how you choose to ship the package - the actual package you use and the actual weight of your package as determined by the carrier. Do I have to ship with USPS?No, USPS is used for calculation purposes only. The estimate is also what your customers are charged. When you actually ship orders, you are free to do so with any carrier you choose.Important:
This feature is only available for merchants in the U.S selling in USD  (except Puerto Rico). Rates calculated during checkout may vary from the final shipping rates determined by USPS.Rate adjustments:If you ship using another carrier and the actual price ends up not being the same as the estimate, your customer is still charged the price shown to them using Real Time Shipping Calculations. To account for the difference, you can add a rate adjustment during setup to ensure that you cover your actual shipping expenses.How do I choose which packaging to use for the purpose of calculations?During setup, you are asked to choose your main package type. This package's details will be used to calculate the estimated shipping rates of all your deliveries, even though you may ship using other boxes (or use other carriers).  Let's look at two examples: During setup, you chose the USPS Small Flat Rate Box and indicated that it can hold two items. A customer buys 3 items from your store. Shipping is calculated as though you ship it using 2 USPS Small Flat Rate Boxes. In actual fact, you may choose to ship the item in one Medium Flat Rate Box.Most of your items are small enough to fit into a USPS Small Flat Rate box, but you do sell some larger items. In this case, you would still choose the USPS Small Flat Rate box during setup. To offset the higher shipping costs for your larger products, you might consider adding a Set Rate Adjustment during step 2 of the setup process. I ship using different sized boxes. Which should I choose as my packaging type?We recommend you select the package you use most often. What is the difference between flat rate packaging and custom packaging?Flat rate envelopes and boxes: When you select a USPS flat rate option, the price is calculated per package (whatever fits in the box). Product weight and destination do not factor into the price for domestic shipping.Custom packaging: Choose the Custom option to calculate the price of delivery with a USPS envelope or box that is not a flat rate option or when you want to ship using any other type of packaging. Shipping costs are calculated based on package weight and customers' address.    Important:Not all shipping services are available for all packaging types. Check your carrier for details. If your shipping and packaging selections are not among the available options – Wix may offer the customer an alternative delivery method. As a result, applicable shipping cost may be adjusted. Step 1 | Prepare your productsShipping calculations can be based on the weight of your products. If you have not already done so, enter a weight for each shippable product.

Note: When adding products in future, make sure to enter a weight.

To add a product's weight:
Click to edit a product. Scroll down to the Inventory & shipping section and enter the Shipping weight. Click Save. Step 2 | Set up a shipping region and choose Calculate with USPSReal Time Shipping Calculation must be set up per region. You can set up as many regions as you like.
Note: Real Time shipping calculations is currently available only for stores in the US selling in USD. If you are based in the US but do not see this option, make sure your address is set to the US and currency is set to USD.
Go to Shipping in your site's dashboard. Edit and existing shipping a default region or create a new one. Select USPS Calculated Rate from the drop-down list.
Step 3 | Choose and customize your shipping servicesFor US regions, the following services are available:

Ground Advantage (Previously called First-Class Mail) - Learn more

Estimated delivery: 2 - 5 business days Suitable for packages up to 70 lbs. (package type restrictions apply)    Priority Mail - Learn more

Delivery within 1 - 3 business days  Suitable for flat rate package    Priority Mail Express - Learn more

Fastest USPS domestic service Suitable for flat rate envelopes    

For international regions,  the following services are available:

First-Class Package International - Learn more

Suitable for packages up to 4 pounds Value of items must not exceed $400 Restrictions may apply based on country destination   Priority Mail International - Learn more

Delivery within 6 - 10 business days    Priority Mail Express international - Learn more 

Delivery within 3 - 5 business days  
When you offer multiple shipping services, your customer can choose one during checkout.

To choose and customize your shipping services:
Select the checkbox next to the service you want to offer. (Optional) Enter an estimated delivery time. (e.g. you can add days to account for handling time).
Note: Customers see this information when selecting a shipping service. (Optional) Set Rate Adjustment (e.g. a $5 handling fee):
Note: Customers will not see this as a separate fee. It appears as part of the total shipping cost.
    
Click to select percentage or amount. Enter the percentage or the adjustment amount.   (Optional) Offer free shipping above a specific amount for this service:
    
Select the Offer free shipping when a customer buys over a certain amount checkbox. Enter the amount or percentage.   Repeat steps 1 - 4 for each service you offer.
Note: If you choose more than one service, all available services are displayed at checkout. Your customers can select the service they prefer.Step 4 | Choose your packagingSelect the package you use most often. This package will be used to calculate all shipping estimates. You do not have to actually ship the order using this package. The main package type is used for calculation purposes.

Note:  Not all shipping services are available for all types of packaging. Check your carrier for details.
Do one of the following:
Select your own package (not a USPS flat rate package) as your package type:
    
Click Custom. Enter a package name. Enter the package dimensions.   Select a flat rate package: 
    
Select a USPS flat rate package type from the Your main shipping package drop-down list.   Enter the maximum number of products you estimate can fit in this box (e.g. if you select 3 products and a customer buys 9 products, shipping is calculated for 3 boxes).  Step 5 | Provide the address you ship fromImportant: To ensure that correct rates apply, provide a 5-digit zip code. Do not add the 4-digit routing number.
Do one of the following:

If no address is displayed:

Enter the address that the package is shipped from.
Note: If you have a separate shipping address (e.g. a warehouse), enter the shipping address. If not, enter your store address.     If an address is displayed and you do not ship from there:

Click Change. Enter the address that the package is shipped from.  Click Done.   If your shipping address is already displayed: Nothing needs to be changed.  Step 6 | Choose a default product weight and shipping rate
Enter a Backup weight per product.
The backup weight is used only when a product was not assigned a weight. If your products vary in weight, we recommend you enter an average weight or the weight of the best selling product.
Notes: 

The weight will apply to all regions with Real Time Shipping Calculations. Backup weight is calculated per order (not per product).    If a backup rate is needed but hasn't been provided, the shipping fee your buyer will be charged is $0.   Enter a Backup shipping rate.
In the unlikely occurrence that shipping cannot be calculated during checkout, this is the shipping rate offered your customer. Learn more
This can happen, for example, when:
    
Communication with USPS is down (rare). You defined one service and you have a product that exceeds the maximum weight allowed for a service (e.g. First Class Mail that exceeds 13 oz.). Any other reason a carrier could not provide a rate.  Step 7 | (Optional) Offer customers local delivery or pickupAfter saving your shipping rule, you can select the region again and add local delivery or pickup options.
Add local delivery Learn how Add store pickup Learn howWant to learn more?Check out the full Wix Learn course on getting started with Wix eCommerce. Skip to the fourth video to learn more about setting up shipping.

source_documents.title: Wix Payments: About the 'Liability Shift'
source_documents.content:
Wix Payments: About the 'Liability Shift'
The 'liability shift' is a term used to describe a change in how banks and processing networks handle some types of credit card fraud. This refers to payments made in person (card present), where the card is read by a card reader.From 2015, businesses that aren’t set up to accept chip cards can now be held financially liable for certain types of fraudulent payments, where a chargeback is filed against the merchant.Having up-to-date card reading technology - such as Wix POS -  is key to avoiding liability for these types of fraud.  Generally speaking, the party supporting the most secure technology for each fraud type will prevail in a chargeback dispute. In the case of a technology tie, the fraud liability remains with the issuer.As a merchant accepting in-person payments, we recommend you verify a customer's payment using a card's EMV chip whenever possible. Having an up-to-date card reader will allow you to insert or tap the chip. You should use the magnetic strip (swipe) only if there is no EMV chip on your customer's card. Learn more about best practices for accepting card payments.

source_documents.title: Accepting Transferred Site Ownership
source_documents.content:
Accepting Transferred Site Ownership
When someone transfers a site to you, you'll receive an email with a link to accept the transfer. If the transferred site has Premium services (e.g. a Premium plan, domain etc.), you'll be asked to enter your billing information for future renewals of those services.In this article:
Accepting site ownership Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Accepting site ownershipSite ownership must be accepted in the Wix account associated with the email address that the site was transferred to. If you do not have a Wix account with this email address, you can create one.To accept site ownership:Check your email account for an email with the subject line Wix Website is Being Transferred to You.Click Accept Transfer in the email and sign in to your Wix account (if you are not already signed in).Note: If you don't have an account, click Sign Up to create one.Review the transfer details and click Next.Enter your billing information and click Next.Enter the domain contact information and click Complete Transfer.Note:If you receive a site without any Premium services, simply click Accept Transfer and sign in to your account (or click Sign Up to create one). You do not need to enter any billing or domain transfer information.FAQsHow do I get my site transferred to me?Site transfers must be initiated from the site owner's account. Once they initiate the transfer, you'll receive an email and you can follow the steps above. If someone created your site for you in another account, contact them and ask them to follow the relevant steps below to transfer the site to you:
Transferring a free Wix site Transferring a Premium Wix siteIf the site owner is no longer available, or you wish to verify ownership, you can fill out the Wix Account Recovery form. Make sure to fill out the entire form (even if you're not completely sure of the answers), and add a detailed explanation of your case, so we can properly verify your ownership. Don't forget to provide us with a valid contact email so we can respond to you.After you submit the form, our team will analyze and review your request.Why do I have to enter my billing information when accepting a site transfer?The billing information that you add during the transfer process is used to renew your paid services at the end of the subscription period. You are not charged while accepting the transfer. These services are set to renew automatically. If you do not want them to, you can switch the auto renewal option off. Can I transfer a Wix Payments account to another Wix account?No, currently it is not possible to transfer a Wix Payments account.How long is the transfer invite valid?The transfer invite is valid for 3 days only. If you don't accept the transfer within 3 days, the invite expires. Once it expires you can ask the original owner to send the invite again either via email or direct link.Will I have access to the transferred site's media files?Yes, site media is associated with a specific Wix site. If you receive a transferred site, you'll have access to all the media files that were uploaded to it. You can find these files in the transferred site's Media Manager. Learn how to access the Media Manager.

source_documents.content:
ADI: Adding and Setting Up Wix Forum
Build and interact with your online community by adding Wix Forum to your site. Post discussion threads, get your site members involved in conversations, comment and share posts, videos, reactions and more.In this article, learn more about:
Adding and setting up Wix Forum Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Adding and setting up Wix Forum
Click Add on the top bar inside ADI. Click Apps. Scroll down to Forum and click Add.
Note: A new page is added to your site called Forum. Access this page from the Pages menu at the top left. Hover over the app and click Manage to create new forum posts, edit posts, and delete posts. Click Design to select a different layout for your forum.  Click the More Actions icon  and click Settings to open the forum settings.


 Set up your forum by customizing the following:General SettingsChoose what you want to customize:
Forum Name: Update the name of your forum.  Forum Description: Describe what your forum is about. Your forum name and description are displayed in the main category list header. Main Page: When you have multiple categories, you can choose to display a post list or a category list on your forum's main page. Sort Posts By: Click the dropdown to choose a criteria such as Most Viewed, Most Liked, or Newest to sort each forum post. Display: Choose which display elements to show with each forum post. Deselect the blue checkmark on the right for the elements you don't want to appear. Show New Posts: Enable or disable the toggle to display or hide new and related posts. Post Auto-Suggest: Enable or disable the toggle to display or hide suggested similar posts. Forum Menu: Enable or disable the toggle to allow site members to log in from the forum. Member Signup Settings: Click the Member Signup button to update the member settings of your site. Note: these options apply to your Member's Area only.Category ListYour forum's main page displays the category list by default. You can change the text of your category list banner in your forum's general settings.Choose what you want to customize:
Header: Show or hide the forum's header and banner image. Subcategories: Show or hide any subcategories from your main category list.Note: To customize your category list you must have more than one category in your forum. To add, edit or rearrange categories first preview your site, click the Settings icon  at the top right of the forum and select + New Category.Post ListEach category of your forum has its own page and post list that displays every post in that category. 
Header: Select or deselect the blue checkmark to show or hide the post list's page header and banner.
Note:  If you want to edit the content of a specific post list banner you can do so from preview or from your live site.
    
Preview your site. Click the Settings icon  at the top right.  Click the More Actions icon  beside the category where you want to change the post list banner content. Click Edit.  PostsWhen someone posts to your forum, they see a toolbar at the bottom of the text box with options of different elements they can add to their post. 


Select or deselect the blue checkmark beside the elements you want to show or hide in the post's toolbar.

FAQsClick a question to learn more about using Wix Forum.How do I create a new post in my forum?Create new posts to share ideas, start an online discussion and keep your users engaged.
Go to your forum page in ADI. Click Manage. Click Create New Post.You can edit a post at any time, even after it is published. Just click the More Actions icon on the relevant post and click Edit post. How do I delete Wix Forum?You can delete and remove Wix Forum from your site at any time. Deleting Forum also removes all of the Forum features and pages.
Click Add on the top bar inside ADI. Click Apps. Hover over Forum and click Delete. Click Delete again to confirm.

source_documents.title: CMS: Adding and Setting Up a Single Item Collection
source_documents.content:
CMS: Adding and Setting Up a Single Item Collection
A single item collection contains one block of content made up of standard fields that you add to. The content you add to these fields can appear on one or more static pages of your website. To display the content, you connect elements on your page to the fields in your collection.This type of collection does not have a table layout in the CMS. It is best suited for non-repeatable content, such as an about page or a single element, like a picture or a text box.Learn more about single item collections.Step 1 | Create a single item collectionWhen you create a collection, you either select a collection with a single item or a collection with multiple items.To create a single item collection:
Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, you can click CMS  in your Editor. Click Create Collection. Enter a name for your collection.  Click the drop-down and select A single item. Click Create. Click + Add Field to start adding fields to your collection. Define the following parameters:
    
Field type: Select the type of content you want to add.  Field name: Enter a name for this field. Field ID: This is used in your code and can’t be changed later.   (Optional) Enter info in the Help text (optional) field. This text appears in the collection only. It won’t show up anywhere on your site. Click Save. Continue to add as many fields as you need for this collection.Step 2 | Connect elements to your single item collectionConnect (or data bind) page elements to the fields in your single item collection by using a dataset. This is the same method you use to connect to a collection with multiple items. New datasets experience: In Wix Studio, we've moved datasets to the Inspector panel on the right to make them easier for you to use. Learn more about the new datasets experience in Wix Studio. To connect elements to your single item collection:
Add a dataset to your page. Select the dataset and click Settings. Click the Connect a collection drop-down and select your single item collection. Click the page element you want to connect. Click the Connect To CMS icon . Click the Connect a dataset drop-down and select the relevant dataset.  Click the Connection Options drop-down and select the required field(s).

source_documents.title: CMS: Displaying Collection Content in a Pro Gallery
source_documents.content:
CMS: Displaying Collection Content in a Pro Gallery
Use a Pro Gallery to dynamically display images for each item in your CMS (Content Management System) collection. You control which image field to use for each item, while also connecting collection fields to the image titles, descriptions, alt texts, and links. This type of setup is ideal for both dynamic list pages and static pages as you can link the images to their items' dynamic item pages. Important:This article refers to connecting a Pro Gallery to an Image field used for displaying one image per collection item. Alternatively, you can connect a gallery to a Media Gallery field used for displaying several images or videos for a single collection item on a dynamic item page. Step 1 | Create a CMS collectionCreate a multiple item collection for storing the images you want to show in the gallery. Add an image field type and text fields for the image titles, descriptions and alt text. Then add the images and values for each item in the collection. If needed, you can adjust the collection permissions from their default 'Show content' setting that allows anyone to view the content. To create a collection for storing gallery images:Wix EditorStudio EditorDashboard
Go to your editor. Click CMS  on the left side of the editor. Click Create Collection. Enter a name for your collection.  Leave Multiple items (Default) selected and click Create.  Add fields to your collection manually or by importing a CSV file:
    
Add fields manually: Click + Add Field to begin adding fields to your collection manually. Import a CSV file: Click Import CSV file to upload a CSV file to your collection.   Tip:Make sure to add an Image field type to store images for each item. You can also add Text field types for use as the image titles, descriptions and alt text. 
Add items to your collection:
    
Click + Add Item. Add content about the item to each relevant field.  Repeat this step to create as many items as you need.   
Set permissions for the collection: 
    
Click More Actions and select Permissions & privacy.  Choose which permissions to use for the collection:
Note: Site owners and collaborators are always treated as admins when logged in to the live site. This means they can always view, add, update, and delete collection content from the live site. This rule applies no matter which collection permission you select.   Show contentAllow the collection content to be viewable on the live site by site visitors. 
Click Show content. Click the Who can view this content? drop-down and choose an option: 
    
Everyone: Any site visitor can view the collection content on the live site.  Members only: Only site members can view the collection content on the live site.    Click Save. Collect contentAllow visitors to add content to the collection with input elements or API.  Note: This permission does not allow visitors to update existing content in the collection. Use the Custom permissions if you want to allow visitors to update existing content. See this FAQ section for more information. 
Click Collect content.  Click the Who can add content to this collection? drop-down and choose an option: 
    
Everyone: Any site visitor can add content to the collection from the live site.  Members only: Only site members can add content to the collection from the live site.    Click the Who can view this content? drop-down and choose an option: 
    
Admin: Site owners and collaborators can view the collection content from the live site.  Members only: Only site members can view the collection content from the live site.  Everyone: Any site visitor can view the collection content from the live site.    Click Save.CustomSet custom permissions to control who can view, add, update, and delete content. Use the "Links connect to" field to link the items to their dynamic item pages, or to a URL, Image, or Video field. Wix EditorStudio Editor
Go to your Editor. Go to the page where you want a gallery to display images representing different collection items.   Click Add Elements  on the left side of the Editor. Click Gallery.  Click and drag the Pro Gallery you want to use onto the page.

Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click Create a New Dataset, then choose the collection you want to connect. Image sources connect to: Select the image field you want to display. Titles connect to: Select the field you want to use for the image titles.  Descriptions connect to: Select the field you want to use for the image descriptions.  Alt texts connect to: Select the field you want to use for the image alt texts. Click the gallery and select Settings to customize your gallery's layout, design, and more. Learn more about customizing your Pro Gallery.  
Go to your Editor. Go to the page where you want a gallery to display images representing different collection items.   Click Add Elements  on the left side of the Editor. Click Gallery.  Remove the default images from the gallery:

Set the mode to Read & Write if you plan on letting visitors submit or edit images in the gallery's connected collection. Wix EditorStudio Editor
Go to the gallery's connected dataset settings:
    
Click the gallery.  Click the Connect to CMS icon  . Click Dataset Settings in the Connect Gallery panel on the right.   Click the Dataset mode drop-down and select and option: 
    
Read: Allow the dataset to display your collection content in the gallery. Read & Write: Allow the dataset to display your collection content in the gallery and allow visitors to add or edit collection content with input elements.    Edit the Maximum items displayed field to adjust the maximum items that can initially load in the gallery.  Click the button and select the Design icon  to customize the appearance of your 'Load More' button. Click Preview to test your 'Load More' button. Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.  Create 'Next Page' and 'Previous Page' buttons
