source_documents.title: Wix Blog: Managing Comments for Your Posts
source_documents.content:
Wix Blog: Managing Comments for Your Posts
Improve engagement on your blog by enabling your community to add comments to your posts. Visitors can also edit their comments, add media to them, reply to other comments, 'like' comments, and sort comments to show the newest or oldest first.You can choose to only allow your site members to add comments, or also let site visitors comment on posts as guests without needing to sign up.Comments are enabled on your posts by default. Blog owners, admins, and editors can enable, disable, and delete comments for any post on your blog. Writers can only manage comments for their own posts. Learn more about roles and permissionsIn this article, learn more about:
Enabling comments for all posts Enabling comments for specific posts Deleting comments on postsEnabling comments for all postsYou can enable or disable comments for all of your blog posts directly from your dashboard. Important:You may be legally responsible for any comments on your site that are the subject of criminal activity, including hate speech, racism, sexism, etc. Visitors who guest comment will be able to comment without accepting your site's terms of use, if it has any.To enable or disable commenting for all posts:
Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions drop-down.  Click Blog settings.  Enable the Comments toggle. Choose who can leave comments on your blog posts:
    
Members only: Only members can leave comments on your blog posts.  Everyone: Anyone that visits your site can leave a comment.
Note: You may see more spam with this option. This is why the ability to upload images within comments is limited to Members only.   Click the Ratings toggle:
    
Enabled: Visitors can leave a star rating when they leave a comment.  Disabled: Visitors cannot leave a star rating when they leave a comment.   Tip:Enable the comments counter in the Blog Feed Display settings to show the number of comments in your posts.Enabling comments for a specific postYou can enable or disable comments for a specific post on your blog in the Blog section of your site's dashboard. To enable comments for a specific post:
Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click the Posts tab. Click Edit next to the relevant post. Click Settings in the panel on the left. Enable the Allow commenting on this post toggle.
Click Publish.Deleting a comment on a postYou can delete post comments from the live version of your blog on your site. To delete a comment:
Go to your blog on your live site. Log in using the email address associated with your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon  next to the comment you want to delete. Click Delete.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Adding a New Item to Your Site Menu
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Adding a New Item to Your Site Menu
Your site menu is the main menu on your website and allows your visitors to navigate around it. Add a variety of items to the menu to ensure your visitors can get to all the information and content that they need.In this article, learn more about:
Adding a new page to your menu Adding a link to your menu Adding a subpage dropdown menu Adding a page section Adding new pages to your site menuWhen you add a new page, a new item is automatically added to your site menu and has the name of the page. You can add a new page to your site from the Pages & Menu panel.To add a new page to your menu:
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu    on the left side of the editor. Click Add Page at the top of the panel. Choose the page template from the options or click + Blank Page. Enter the new page name. Click Done.Tip:If you rename the page in the Pages & Menu panel, it automatically updates on your site menu. It also goes the other way around – if you rename the item on your site menu, it automatically updates the Pages & Menu panel.Adding a link to your site menuAdd any link you need to your site menu, whether it's an external URL, an email address, a document, etc. The link looks like a regular item on your site menu, but when your visitors click it, the link destination opens. Choose whether it opens in the same window or a new window.To add a link to your menu:
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu    on the left side of the editor. Click the Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel. Click Link. Select the link type and enter the link details.  Choose whether your link opens in a new window or the current window.  Click Done. Enter the name for the menu item. Click Done.Adding a subpage dropdown menuCreate a dropdown subpage menu within your site navigation to keep it organized and user-friendly. Choose between two options: turn an existing menu item into a clickable title for your dropdown, or add a new non-clickable menu title to organize your subitems beneath it.To add a dropdown menu:
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu    on the left side of the editor. Choose what to do next:Clickable title (i.e. menu item)Drag and drop a menu item to nest it under another item, turning it into a subpage. 

Decide which menu item should be the submenu title. Drag all relevant menu items into the dropdown.

 Non-clickable titleAdd the dropdown as a new menu item and give it a title to nest additional items beneath it.

Click Add Menu Item. Click Dropdown.  Enter the item title.  Click Done. Drag all relevant menu items into the new dropdown title.


Adding a page section to your site menuSections are a great way to divide and organize your page content. Link to sections from your site menu so your visitors can be directed there with one click.To add a section to your site menu:
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu    on the left side of the editor. Click Add Menu Item at the bottom of the pages panel. Click Section. Select the page the section is on from the dropdown menu. Select the section from the dropdown menu. Click Done.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Saving, Previewing and Publishing Your Site
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Saving, Previewing and Publishing Your Site
Manage your site from within the Editor to keep it updated, and to keep any new changes that you've made. You can save, preview, and publish your site from the Editor at any time. In this article, learn how to:
Save your site Preview your site Publish your site Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Saving your siteYour site is automatically saved regularly as you are working in the Editor. It starts after the first manual save on your site.   Even with autosave, we still recommend that you save your site regularly as you are building it, to avoid losing any changes. To save your site:
Click Save at the top right of the Editor. Click Done in the pop-up window.Previewing your siteYou can preview your site without publishing it to see what it looks like to visitors. This is a great way to test how new changes and updates look before publishing them. To preview your site:
Click Preview at the top right of the Editor. Browse your site preview. Click Back to Editor to go back to the Editor.Note: Viewing your site Preview will trigger an automatic autosave, regardless of whether autosave has been disabled.Publishing your siteYou need to publish your site for the changes to be made live on the Internet. You can publish new changes to your site at any time by clicking Publish at the top right of the Editor. Learn more about publishing your siteFAQsClick a question below to learn more about saving, previewing and publishing.How do I turn autosave off?You can turn Autosave on or off in your Editor by pressing Ctrl + Alt + A on your keyboard (Command ⌘ + Option + A on Mac).Note: Adding apps to your site triggers an automatic autosave, regardless of whether autosave has been disabled.Can I leave the Editor without saving?Your site is automatically saved regularly. However, if you make changes in the Wix Editor and decide that you do not want to save them, you can exit the Editor without saving by closing the browser window or navigating away from the Wix Editor. Your browser will display a pop-up message warning you that unsaved changes will be lost. Click Leave Page to confirm. If the changes saved, you can always go back to a previous version using your site history.How do I hide a page from my site if it's not ready for my visitors to see?If you are still working on a certain page, you can hide it from your site menu until you're ready for visitors to see it. Learn more about hiding pages from menusCan I go back to a previous saved or published version of my site?You can restore and republish an older version of your site at any time. Learn how to view and restore previous versions of your site

source_documents.title: Wix Logo: Designing and Ordering Business Cards in the Wix Logo Maker
source_documents.content:
Wix Logo: Designing and Ordering Business Cards in the Wix Logo Maker
Elevate your brand by creating personalized business cards with the Wix Logo Maker. Choose from a range of card templates and customize the content, font, colors, images and more to make it your own.With the Wix Logo Maker, you can create as many business card designs as you want, and purchase them later. You'll find all your designs under your Brand Designs in the Brand Studio.Step 1 | Select a card templateStart off by selecting the brand you want to work on. Then, choose a template from our range of professional business card designs. 
Go to the Brand Studio. Click the My Brands drop-down at the top. Select the relevant brand.
Scroll to the Design a branded business card section. Click Customize on the template you like best. 
Tip: Click Explore all to view more template suggestions.Step 2 | Customize your business cardAfter choosing your card's template, you can start designing it from the business card editor. From this editor you can customize the card's text, image, color and more.Click an option below to learn how to customize it:Template
Click the Templates icon  to choose a new card template. Scroll through the available templates and select the one you like best.
Palette
Click the Palette icon  to change the card's color palette. Scroll through the available color palettes and select the one you like best.
Text
Click the Text icon  on the left. Hover over the text you want to customize and click Customize.
Note: If you haven't yet added text, click Add Text. Customize the text using the following options:
    
Edit text: Click the text field to replace the text. Font: Click Change Font to select a new font. Scroll through the available fonts and click the one you like best. Alignment: Select your text's alignment (left, center, right). Text fill color: Click the color box to change the text's color. Choose from the colors based on your color palette, or add a new color. Fill color opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the text. Outline width: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the outline around your text. Text outline color: Click the color box to choose the color of your text's outline, or enter a HEX code. Size: Drag the slider to change the text's size (between 1 and 400 pixels) Letter spacing: Drag the slider to adjust the space between the letters. Flip: Click the relevant icon to flip the text horizontally or vertically. Rotate: Drag the slider to rotate the text. Text Curve: Drag the slider to bend the text into a curve. Horizontal position: Drag the slider to move the text left or right. Vertical position: Drag the slider to move the text up or down. Shadow: Click the toggle to enable a shadow behind the text and edit the following:
        
Shadow color: Click the color box to select the shadow's color. Shadow opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the shadow's transparency. Shadow horizontal position: Drag the slider to move the shadow left or right. Shadow vertical position: Drag the slider to move the shadow up or down. Shadow blur: Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the shadow.   Blur: Click the toggle to enable blurring. Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the text.
  Symbols
Click the Symbols icon on the left. Hover over the icon you want to edit and click Customize.
Tip: To add your logo to the card, click Add next to Manage Symbols, then click My Logos and select your logo.
 Customize your icon using the following options:
    
Icon: Click Change icon to replace the existing icon. Color: Click the color box to edit the logo's color.  Opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the icon. Size: Drag the slider to change the icon's size. Flip: Click the relevant icon to flip the icon horizontally or vertically. Rotate: Drag the slider to rotate the icon. Horizontal position: Drag the slider to move the icon left or right. Vertical position: Drag the slider to move the icon up or down. Shadow: Click the toggle to enable a shadow behind the icon and edit the following:
        
Shadow color: Click the color box to select the shadow's color. Shadow opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the shadow's transparency. Shadow horizontal position: Drag the slider to move the shadow left or right. Shadow vertical position: Drag the slider to move the shadow up or down. Shadow blur: Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the shadow.   Blur: Click the toggle to enable blurring. Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the icon.
  Shapes
Click the Shapes  icon on the left.
Note: If you haven't yet added a shape, click Add Shape. Hover over the shape you want to edit and click Customize.  Edit the shape by using the following options: 
    
Shape: Click Change to select a new shape you want to add to your logo. Fill color: Click the toggle to enable color inside the shape's border.  Color: Click the color box to select the shape's color. Opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the shape's color.  
Border: Click the toggle to display a border around your shape, then edit the following:
    
Border width: Drag the slider to adjust the width of your shape's border. Border color: Click the color box to select the shape's border color. Border opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the border's opacity.   Width: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the shape's width. Height: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the shape's height. Flip: Click the relevant icon to flip the shape horizontally or vertically. Rotate: Drag the slider to rotate the shape. Horizontal position: Drag the slider to move the shape left or right. Vertical position: Drag the slider to move the shape up or down. Shadow: Click the toggle to enable a shadow behind the shape and edit the following:
    
Shadow color: Click the color box to select the shadow's color. Shadow opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the shadow's transparency. Shadow horizontal position: Drag the slider to move the shadow left or right. Shadow vertical position: Drag the slider to move the shadow up or down. Shadow blur: Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the shadow.   Blur: Click the toggle to enable blurring. Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the shape.
Tip: Narrow down your search for your shape using the filter option in the Add Shape panel.
Images
Click the Images icon  on the left. Upload an image or select an image from the Wix Exclusive Images library:
    
Upload an image: 

Click + Upload. Click + Upload Media.  Select the image(s) you want to upload and click Open. Click Add to Logo.   Use a Wix Exclusive image:

Type your keywords into the search bar and press Enter on your keyboard.  (Optional) Click the Orientation or Color drop-down to filter your search.  Hover over the image you want to use and click Add.     Customize your image using the following options:
    
Size: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of your image. Opacity: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the transparency of your image. Flip: Flip your image horizontally or vertically. Rotate: Drag the slider to rotate your image. Horizontal position: Drag the slider to move your image left or right. Vertical position: Drag the slider to move your image up or down. Shadow: Click the toggle to enable a shadow around your image and edit the following:
        
Shadow color: Click the color box to select the shadow's color or enter a hex code. Shadow opacity: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the transparency of your shadow. Shadow horizontal position: Drag the slider to move your shadow left or right. Shadow vertical position: Drag the slider to move your shadow up or down. Shadow blur: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the blurriness of your shadow.   Blur: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the blurriness of your image.
  Background
Click the Background icon  on the left. Click the color box to change the background color. Choose from the suggested colors or select your own.
Element arrangementYou can easily adjust an element's location or reposition it using the toolbar below:
To reposition elements using the Align drop-down:
Click the element you want to reposition. Click Align on the toolbar. Select the position you want to move your element into.
To rearrange elements using the same toolbar:
Click the element you want to arrange. Click the relevant option:
    
 Move forward: Moves the element forward one layer.  Move backward: Moves the element backward one layer.  Duplicate: Adds a copy of your element to the canvas.  Delete: Deletes the element.
  Tip:You can press Ctrl + A or Cmd + A (if you're using a Mac) to select and group all the elements on your card, and move them around the canvas.Step 3 | Order your business card printsOnce you've customized your card and you're happy with the design, you can order your physical cards through your dashboard. To order printed merchandise from the Logo Maker, you need to purchase the logo design first.To order your business cards:
Click Order Prints. Review Order a Print information and click OK to proceed. Click the Paper Type drop-down menu and select the paper thickness and finish you want. Click the Quantity drop-down menu and select how many cards you want to order (100, 250, or 500 cards). Click Add to Cart.
Click Continue to Checkout. Enter your shipping details and click Save & Continue. Confirm your payment method and click Submit Purchase.Want to reorder previously printed cards?If you submitted your initial order through the standalone business card maker, follow the steps below:
Click Order History. Click View Items beside the relevant order. Click Order Again. Optional: Click Customize below the card preview to make any changes.If you ordered business cards from the Logo Maker, rather than the separate business card maker, your designs will be saved within your associated brand where you can make any edits and submit new orders.Step 4 | (Optional) View your order historyYou can go back and review your order history at any time to check details such as your payment amount and order date. To view your order history:
Click the Brand Actions drop-down. Click View Print Orders.

source_documents.title: Wix Pro Gallery: Customizing Your Gallery's Advanced Settings
source_documents.content:
Wix Pro Gallery: Customizing Your Gallery's Advanced Settings
The settings available in the Advanced tab allow you to take your Pro Galley to the next level. Here you can focus on setting the quality of your videos and images, gallery direction and connecting Lightroom Classic to your gallery.In this article, learn more about:
Customizing the advanced settings Advanced settings glossaryCustomizing the advanced settingsUsing the Pro Gallery's advanced settings, you can give your gallery that pro-touch.To customize the advanced settings:
Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Advanced tab. Customize the advanced settings using the options available (see table below).Advanced settings glossaryRead on to learn more about the options available in the Advanced Setting tab.SettingExplanationOptionsPlay VideosControl how your videos play.- On Hover: Your videos play when your visitors hover over them in the gallery. - Autoplay: Your videos play automatically in the gallery. - On click: Your videos play when your visitors click them in the gallery.Play with SoundYour videos in your gallery are muted by default. Control if your videos play with sound.- Enabled: Videos play with sound in the gallery view. - Disabled: Videos are muted in the gallery view. Your videos always play with sound in expand mode.Playback SpeedControl the playback speed of the videos.Select the playback speed from the options.Loop VideoControl if your gallery's videos play continuously or if visitors need to click them.
This setting enables each video in your gallery to play in a loop. - Enabled: Your videos play continuously. - Disabled: Your site visitors need to click the play icon to play your videos.Show play buttonChoose to enable or disable the play icon in Pro Gallery Videos. - Enabled: A play icon will appear on your videos. - Disabled: Your videos will not have a play icon. Gallery directionChoose to display your gallery items from left-to-right or right-to-left.Click the relevant checkbox to display your gallery items from left-to-right or right-to-left.Image QualitySelect the image quality of your gallery items.Drag the slider to increase or decrease the quality of the images in your gallery.
Note: Using higher quality might cause your images to load slower.Image SharpeningSharpen your gallery images.- Enabled: The images are  sharpened. Customize the amount, radius and threshold of the sharpening.
- Disabled: The images are not sharpenedConvert images to WebPWebP is an image format that makes images on the web smaller by 25-35%. Improves site loading time. - Enabled:(Recommended) Images are converted to a WebP format.- Disabled: Images display in their original file format. This may affect site loading time.Automatically resize imagesWix automatically resizes gallery images to optimize image loading time and preserve site visitor's viewing experience.Click the drop-down to choose when images are resized.- Always (recommended): Gallery images are automatically resized to improve your site's loading time.- Gallery Only: Only images in the main view of the Pro Gallery are resized. Images in the Expand Mode display in their original resolution.- Never: Images load in their original resolution. This may affect site loading time.Lightroom IntegrationUsing the Wix Pro Gallery plugin, you can upload photos from Lightroom Classic directly to your gallery.Click Download Plug-in and follow these instructions.

source_documents.title: Wix Restaurants: Managing Your Notifications for Table Reservations
source_documents.content:
Wix Restaurants: Managing Your Notifications for Table Reservations
There are 3 types of notifications available with the Wix Table Reservations app:
When a reservation is created  When a reservation is requested When a reservation is canceledChoose to receive these notifications via your site's dashboard and/or email. By default, these notifications are enabled, but you can turn them on or off at any time.Additionally, you can enable push notifications on your mobile device through the Wix app and choose which notifications to receive and from which locations.DashboardWix app
 Go to Table Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click Settings at the top right. Click Notifications. Click Manage Notifications under Notifications preferences. Click the Dashboard drop-down and enable the notifications you want to receive in your Wix dashboard. Click the Email drop-down and enable the notifications you want to receive to your email.Make sure to allow notifications from the Wix app in the settings of your mobile device. 
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap the Notifications icon  at the top. Tap the More Actions icon . Tap Manage notifications. Tap the Allow Push Notifications toggle to enable or disable the relevant notifications:
    
Enabled: You receive push notifications from the notification types of your choice. Tap the toggle next to the relevant notification type to enable or disable it. After disabling a notification, choose how long you want to mute notifications for.
        
Note: To enable notifications for specific locations, tap one of the Wix Table Reservations notifications and select which locations you want to receive notifications from.   Disabled: All notifications are disabled. Select the time frame you want to disable all notifications for.  Note:Email notifications for table reservations are sent to your Wix account email address and not the business address set in your business info. If you'd like others to also receive these notifications, you can invite them to manage your restaurant. You can also set up an automation to select additional notifications for table reservations and select the email addresses that should receive them.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Managing the Slides in Your Slideshow
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Managing the Slides in Your Slideshow
Create the perfect slideshow by organizing your slides to show the content you want.In this article, learn more about:
Adding a new slide to your slideshow Changing the order of the slides Duplicating slides Renaming your slides Deleting slidesHaven't added a slideshow yet?Learn how to add and set up your slideshow first.Adding new slides to your slideshowHave new and important content? Add a new slide to your slideshow so your visitors can get all the information they need.To add a new slide:
Click the slideshow in your editor. Click Manage Slides. Click Add New Slide at the bottom.Reordering slides in your slideshowRearrange your slides to change the order in which your content is displayed to your visitors.To reorder your slides:
Click the slideshow in your editor. Click Manage Slides. Click the Reorder icon  on the left of the relevant slide and drag it to your chosen position.Duplicating slides in your slideshowIf you like the look and layout of a slide and would like to add another one that looks similar, you can  duplicate the slide and customize it as needed.To duplicate a slide:
Click the slideshow in your editor. Click Manage Slides. Click the slide from the list. Click Duplicate Slide at the bottom.Renaming your slidesGive your slides names to help you easily identify them while editing or managing your slideshow. We recommend choosing a name that represents the slide's content.Note:The names of your slides are only visible in the editor. Your visitors cannot see them on the live site.To rename your slides
Click the slideshow in your editor. Click Manage Slides. Hover over the relevant slide and click the More Actions icon . Click Rename. Enter your slide name in the text field. Click Done.Deleting slides from your slideshowIf you no longer need a slide, you can delete it to keep your slideshow up to date.To delete a slide:
Click the slideshow in your editor. Click Manage Slides. Hover over the relevant slide and click the More Actions icon . Click Delete.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Viewing a Wix Site Using Firefox on Android
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Viewing a Wix Site Using Firefox on Android

source_documents.title: Wix Events: About Automated Emails for Events
source_documents.content:
Wix Events: About Automated Emails for Events
Wix Automations is a powerful tool that lets you set an action in motion whenever a specific trigger occurs. How automated emails can help your events businessYou can manage your interactions with event guests automatically. For example, you can send an email with information about an event any time someone RSVPs. You can also encourage guests to come back by offering a coupon and sending it a day after an event ends.Important:
Clients always receive emails (not automations) when buying tickets. This email cannot be disabled because it contains the ticket.  Clients receive emails (not automations) when they RSVP for an event or join a waitlist. These emails can be disabled. Tip:Automations can also be used to send notifications or tasks to you or your team members.Choose what triggers an automatic emailTo create an automation, you need to select a trigger - the thing that sets the automation in motion. As a Wix Events user, you can select one of the triggers designed specifically to work with Wix Events.Tip:If you don't see this screen, click Create an Automation and then Start from Scratch.You can apply the same automation to all your events. Alternatively, you can apply an automation to one or more specific events. This allows you to tailor your automation to the event. Guest purchases ticket / Guest RSVPsThere may be information you want to share only after a guest registers for your event. By creating an automation that's triggered by a ticket purchase or RSVP reply, you can do so automatically.Guest is added to waitlist triggerYou can allow guests to be added to a waitlist when registration to an RSVP event is full. By sending an automation after a guest adds themselves to the waitlist, you can let them know what to expect.Event ends triggerKeep in touch with your guests after an event has ended. Use the opportunity to review the past event or mention other events that are coming up.  Ready to get started?Find out more about how to create an automation. When you're ready, go to Automations in your site's dashboard.

When new members join When the group description or cover image changes When an event is connected

New Members Group Details New Events  FAQsClick a question below to learn more. Can I search for posts in my group? Yes. You can search for posts in your group by using the search feature. It lets you quickly find important discussions and keep track of ongoing conversations. This can help improve group engagement and make managing your group more efficient. To search for a specific post, just go to your group page, click on the search icon, and enter keywords related to the post you're looking for. How do I add media to posts that have already been published?You can add media to a published post at any time from your live site. To see how many people have looked at your posts, go to any of your posts and look for the view counter, which appears next to your post. source_documents.title: Wix Media: Uploading Media to the Media Manager
source_documents.content:
Wix Media: Uploading Media to the Media Manager
Upload your own media files to the Media Manager so that you can add them to your site at any time. You can upload media directly from your computer, other Wix sites in your account, your social media accounts, and even via a URL.Which media file types and sizes are supported?Your Wix site supports a variety of media file types and sizes. Learn more about the file types you can uploadIn this article, learn more about:
Uploading your media Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Uploading your mediaUpload your media to your site from a variety of locations via the Media Manager.To upload your media:
Go to your Media Manager. Click Upload Media. Select where you want to add the media from:Your computer
Drag and drop files into the Media Manager or click Upload from Computer.  Select the files you want to upload. Click Open.Your other Wix sites
Click My Wix Account.  Select the site folder. Select the files you want to upload. Click Upload Selection.Social networks
Select the social network.  Click Connect. Select the files you want to upload. Click Upload Selection.A URL
Click the Link icon on the left side. Paste the URL link and click Import. FAQsClick a question below to learn more about uploading to the Media Manager:Can I upload an SVG file created from the Wix Logo Maker?Currently, you can't upload the SVG file of a logo you created with the Wix Logo Maker to the Media Manager, if the logo contains uploaded PNG or JPG images. You can, however, upload the PNG version of your logo instead.Will my upload be interrupted if I close the Media Manager?Your media continues uploading even if you close the Media Manager.Where does the media I upload to the Wix app go?Any media you upload to the Wix app can be found in the Mobile Uploads folder in the Media Manager.How can I tell how much storage space I have left?You can view how much storage space you have left directly from the Media Manager. Learn how to view your site's storage spaceI don't have a Premium plan. Is there a limit on the length of videos I can upload?There is a storage limit of 10GB for sites without a Premium plan. If you need to upload a larger video, you can upgrade to a Premium plan to increase the storage available to you. Learn more about upgrading your video storage.

Wix SMS: Upgrading Wix SMS
Your upgraded site plan includes a certain number of SMS messages per month. To send more messages, purchase a Wix SMS plan. This is a standalone plan that works by "boosting" the number of messages in your plan.In this article, learn more about:
Purchasing a Wix SMS plan Upgrading your siteBefore you begin:
Wix SMS is not yet available for all users. If it is available on your site, you need to upgrade your site to start using it. Currently, Wix SMS allows you to send pre-installed texts for Wix Bookings, Wix Table Reservations, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New). You can't create your own automations or compose your own messages.Purchasing a Wix SMS planYou can purchase or upgrade an existing Wix SMS plan from your site's dashboard.To purchase a Wix SMS plan:
Go to SMS Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Get More Texts.
Click Select under the plan you would like to purchase:
    
Starter: 500 monthly texts Essentials: 1,000 monthly texts Professional: 2,500 monthly texts
Note: At this time, the Professional plan is the largest plan we offer, but if your business requires more texts, you can request it. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.Upgrading your siteEach of our plans includes a certain number of SMS messages per month. source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Notifying Customers when Products Are Back in Stock
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Notifying Customers when Products Are Back in Stock
Make sure you don't miss out on potential sales when items are out of stock. Note:Collecting customer requests, and sending automated notifications to customers, are enabled separately.In this article, learn more about:
Collecting customer requests  Activating customer notifications Customizing the notification email  Pausing the back-in-stock featureVideo tutorialCheck out this short video tutorial, or scroll down to read the full article.
Collecting customer requestsEnable customer requests so that your customers can let you know they're interested in an out-of-stock item.Once enabled, every time a customer requests to be notified, the following happens:
The "Add to Cart" button changes to "Notify When Available" when an product is out of stock.  You get an email notification.  The request appears in the Back in Stock Requests tab in your site's dashboard.  The customer gets notified when the item is back in stock (unless you deactivated this option).To start collecting customer requests:
Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab in your site's dashboard. Click Start Collecting Requests.Activating customer notificationsAfter you start collecting requests, you can activate automated notifications so that customers get an email when the product they like is back in stock.To activate automated notifications:
Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab in your site's dashboard. Click Activate Automation.Customizing the notification emailYour customers receive an email when the product they're interested is back in stock. The email has a "Buy Now" button to make it easy for customers to purchase it.Make sure you customize the design of the notification email so it matches your store's branding. To customize the design of the notification:
Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab in your site's dashboard. Click the Automations tab.
 Click Preview & Edit. Edit the Sender Details:
    
Click Edit. Edit the "from" name.
Note: Enter a name customers recognize like your business name. (Optional) Edit the reply-to email.
Tip: This is where emails are directed if customers reply. Click Save.   Customize the notification:
    
Click Edit Template to customize the text and design of the notification.
Tip: Click Add and then Logo to display your logo at the top of the notification. Click Save & Publish.  Tip:To see what the email looks like when sent to customers, go back to the Automations tab, click Preview & Edit again and select Preview & Test.
From there you can click Send Test Email and enter your details to get the notification sent to your inbox. Pausing the back-in-stock featureYou can pause the collecting requests feature so customers can no longer sign up to get notified. You can also pause the sending of back-in-stock notifications to customers - or stop both. Note:If you stop collecting new requests, customers who requested notifications still receive them, as long as automated notifications is still enabled.To pause the back-in-stock feature:
Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab in your site's dashboard. Stop collecting requests:
Note: When an item is out of stock, the "Add to Cart" button text changes to "Out of Stock".
    
Click the More Actions icon  at the top right. Click Pause requests. Click Pause requests to confirm.   Stop sending automated back-in-stock notifications (available if you haven't stopped collecting requests):
Note: Customers will not be not notified when you restock an item.
    
Click the Automations tab. Disable the Active toggle.  Want to learn more?Check out the full course in Wix Learn on building your store or skip to the video on back in stock notifications.

source_documents.title: Wix Studio FAQs: Getting Started
source_documents.content:
Wix Studio FAQs: Getting Started
Wix Studio is a flexible, end-to-end platform for agencies and enterprises who offer bespoke and scalable web creation services. The advanced responsive editor has game-changing design tools like responsive AI, open platform capabilities, and one workspace to manage your sites, assets and team. It allows you to efficiently deliver exceptional websites that exceed your clients' vision. Learn more about Wix StudioBelow we'll answer some of the common questions we've received about getting started with Wix Studio. Switching to Wix StudioClick a question below to learn more about switching to Wix StudioHow can I get access to Wix Studio?Wix Studio is available to everyone. If you're an agency or enterprise already using Wix or Editor X, you can switch your account to a Wix Studio account. You'll find multiple entry points prompting you to switch, including through the Sites page in your dashboard, the dashboard of any site you own, the Templates page, and the Account Settings menu.On switching, you'll land on the Discover page of your new Wix Studio workspace and can find all the educational resources you need to get started.
You can also access Wix Studio via an email invitation to join a team. If invited to a Wix Studio team, click to accept the invite, log in and go to your team's Wix Studio workspace.

Finally, we have paths to sign up via our mobile apps too. Sign up via a link in the Wix mobile app or download the newly launched Wix Studio app, available on iOS and Android, and start your journey from there.After moving to Wix Studio, will I still have access to the sites I've built on Editor X and Wix?Yes. Once you transition to Wix Studio, all of your sites will be available in your Sites tab, within the Wix Studio workspace.Using Editor X?By April 2024, you'll no longer be able to create new Editor X sites, as part of the transition process. For this reason, we highly recommend using Wix Studio for any new projects you get. If you've never used Editor X before, the option to create new sites is now closed. Learn more about updating an Editor X site to Wix Studio.What are the Premium pricing plans for Wix Studio?Visit the Wix Studio Premium plans page for pricing and details.How can Wix Studio help my agency?Wix Studio is designed especially for agencies, and comes equipped with all the tools an agency needs to see projects, of any scale, through from end to end.

The advanced, responsive Studio Editor allows both deep control and intuitive creation, so designers can adapt depending on the client, their workflow or personal preference. Tools like Responsive AI, proportional scaling and preset layouts, speed up the build process when turnaround times are tight. For complex sites, full CSS control allows you to create intricate layouts and interactions, while open APIs, SPIs and integrations give you the ability to extend any site's functionality. Cater to clients in any industry by connecting powerful Wix business solutions for eCommerce, Bookings, Events and more, no third-party tools or plugins needed. Plus, shared and reusable design assets, including templates, give you next-level efficiency on project after project.

The Wix Studio workspace provides an open and collaborative environment that's ideal for agency work. Account owners have a clear view of all sites, projects and assets in one centralized place, and can stay in control over who-does-what with detailed site permissions. Multiple teammates can work on the same site at the same time, while on-canvas feedback provides a faster, more streamlined feedback loop. When it comes to client handover, you can share completed projects in a seamless, professional way— you can even add personalized resources, specific to your clients' needs, right to their dashboard. Plus, you can reinforce your agency's work and maintain connections with automated emails that notify your clients of their site's monthly analytics.Can I use Wix Studio in any country?Wix Studio is available to millions of users in over 190 countries. You can view country limitations here.If I switch to Wix Studio and then want to switch back, can I?Yes. If you feel that Wix Studio is not for you, you can leave Wix Studio and switch to the regular Wix experience. When you leave, some Wix Studio features will no longer be available. For Wix Partners, this decision also means leaving the Partner Program altogether and losing access to exclusive benefits, features and points. Learn more about leaving Wix Studio.Learn more about switching to Wix Studio.Using Wix StudioClick a question below to learn more about using Wix Studio.Where can I learn how to use Wix Studio?You can learn how to use Wix Studio through our dedicated educational hub, Wix Studio Academy. There you'll find the Essentials course to get you fully up to speed with the platform and its capabilities, as well as standalone how-to tutorials. Additionally, our experts will host a series of ongoing educational events and webinars, covering everything from design to development. From your new workspace, you'll find sandboxes to experiment with features like responsive design, and in the Studio Editor there are tooltips and videos to guide you along the way. Go to the Wix Studio Academy.Do I need to be a designer or a developer to learn Wix Studio?Wix Studio is for all professionals, including designers, developers and marketers, from large-scale agencies to enterprises. While design and development knowledge will benefit Wix Studio users, the platform's intuitive visual drag-and-drop canvas and out-of-the-box solutions mean a shorter learning curve.What is responsive design on Wix Studio?With the Wix Studio Editor, you can use AI to make site pages and sections instantly responsive—in just a couple of clicks. You can create custom breakpoints, use modular flex layouts and take advantage of out-of-the-box responsive behaviors, like scale proportionally, to build smarter and more efficiently than ever before. For those who want it, deep CSS control allows you to create high-end websites with complex layouts and interactions.How does collaboration work in Wix Studio?Wix Studio offers a collaborative environment designed to support your entire workflow. In the Studio Editor, you and your teammates can work side-by-side and get instant feedback, from colleagues or clients, with on-canvas comments. In the new workspace, you can efficiently manage multiple teams, projects and assets from one centralized place. You can also switch between workspaces, so you don't need to create additional accounts to work on different teams. Experience seamless collaboration with your clients too—take granular control over who does what with roles and permissions, get their feedback on your work in progress and add a personalized selection of resources to their dashboard.What are reusable assets?Reusable assets are assets you create that you can use, reuse and share. This includes sections, custom templates and widgets.If I experience a bug, what should I do?If you experience a bug, we're here to assist you promptly. Reach out to a Wix Studio Customer Care expert by starting a live chat or requesting a callback.Additionally, Wix Studio features a dedicated tab where you can view your team's entire Customer Care ticket log. This allows you to track previous interactions and issues raised by anyone in your workspace to Wix Customer Care, providing a comprehensive overview of their statuses and resolutions. Learn more about viewing your Customer Care ticket log.Does Wix Studio have ready-made templates?Wix Studio has several designer-made responsive website templates, covering a broad range of industries and design styles that you can also use to create sites without needing to start from scratch. There are also some ready-made wireframes for you to choose from and add your own style.Does Wix Studio have a mobile app for business management, like the Wix app?Yes, we're excited to launch a new mobile app for Wix Studio, designed to help you stay in control while on the move. You’ll be able to manage your agency’s site, projects and clients, and access the Marketplace where you can view and manage leads, reply to contacts and get paid. You can also easily manage your clients' sites, reach out to customer support and get updates on your tickets' status. Plus, you can view and switch between workspaces in your account, so you can stay on top of every project on your plate. You'll have all the capabilities of the Wix app—and more.If you prefer, you can use the Wix app to manage your Wix Studio sites. You can easily switch between workspaces and your Site List will change depending on which workspace you're in. However, for an enhanced user experience with more specific features for Wix Studio users, we recommend you use the new Wix Studio app.If I have more questions about Wix Studio, who can I reach out to?There are many ways to reach out and get advice, whether it's from like-minded professionals or Customer Care experts. Visit the Wix Studio Forum, a dedicated hub for getting answers, finding solutions and asking for feedback among your peers.

Join the Wix Partner Community and Wix Studio Discord to reach out with your questions.

We've also created a bank of  Wix Studio help articles to answer the most anticipated questions, but if you still have some our Customer Care experts will be happy to assist you.Will you be offering special prices on Premium plans for agencies?We created Wix Studio Premium plans with Partner feedback in mind. Log out of your Wix account to view the plans here.Read our full article to learn more about Wix Studio.

source_documents.title: ADI: Accessing Your Form's Submissions Table
source_documents.content:
ADI: Accessing Your Form's Submissions Table
Every time a visitor submits a form on your site, their response is recorded in a submissions table. This makes it easy to see all the form responses in one view, and helps you keep track of your visitors and their requests. You can edit and filter your submissions, and also import or export data to or from your form.Below is an example of a submissions table:Accessing Your Form Submissions Table from the ADI BuilderView your submissions table directly from inside the ADI builder.To view your submissions from the ADI builder:Click the section that contains your form in the ADI builder.Click Edit next to Form.Click Form Settings. Click View Table under Submissions Table.Accessing Your Form Submissions Table from the DashboardEasily access your form submissions table from the dashboard of your site.To view form submissions from your site's dashboard:Go to your site's dashboard.Click Customer Management.Click Form Submissions. Click View Table on the relevant form.Important:To view your submissions, you must first publish your site.

CMS Request: Connecting Section Backgrounds in the Studio Editor to the CMS

This allows you to manage the images that appear as section backgrounds in your CMS collections. In the Studio Editor, select a section and go to the CMS tab of the Inspector panel to connect the section background. Learn more about connecting elements to the CMS.

source_documents.title: Creating a QR Code with the Wix QR Code Generator
source_documents.content:
Creating a QR Code with the Wix QR Code Generator
Create your very own QR (Quick Response) code, for people to scan and get to the action you want. The code can lead to a URL, a vCard, your email and much more.Once you download your QR code (free of charge), you can upload it directly to your site, social media, or even add it to your branding materials.Tell me more about QR codesA QR (Quick Response) code is a type of barcode. It holds information that can be read by a QR code scanner, usually a smartphone camera or app, and can be shared online or printed.QR codes boast many benefits. They can streamline an ordering process by sending users directly to menus, offer a fast and easy way to connect to WiFi, and even generate leads by sending users to a sign-up form.In this article, learn more about:
Creating a QR code Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Creating a QR codeCreate your QR code by choosing the type of content you wish to direct your visitors to. This could be text, a link or an image, for example. You can can then select the size and color of your QR code. To create a QR code:
Go to the QR Code Generator. Click Create QR Code. Select the content type you want your QR code to direct your users to: Text, URL, Image, Email, PDF, and more. Enter / upload the relevant details / content.
Customize your QR code using the following options:
    
Select Size: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the final size of your QR Code. You can create a code of maximum size 1000 x 1000 px, and minimum size 100 x 100 px. Colors: Choose the background and dots colors of your QR code.  
Click Download. Select the file type you want to download your QR code as: PNG, SVG, or JPEG.FAQsClick a question below to learn more about creating QR codes:What types of QR codes can I create? There are many types of QR codes that you can create for your business. These include:
Turn a link into a QR code QR code for a business card QR code for a restaurant menu  QR code to an image PDF to a QR code QR code for a website QR code for a video QR code for WiFiWill my QR code ever expire?No. QR codes never expire. The only time your code might ‘expire’ is when the destination URL is changed or deleted. Downloaded QR codes are static images and it is not possible for them to change once downloaded. Is there a scan limit for QR codes?No. There is no limit to how many times your QR code can be scanned.Can I track how many times a QR code was scanned?It is not currently possible to track how many times a code was scanned / clicked.What's next?Upload your QR code to your site, your social media, or get it printed on business cards using the Wix Logo Maker.

source_documents.title: Email Marketing: Sending Your Campaign to a Segment
source_documents.content:
Email Marketing: Sending Your Campaign to a Segment
Send an email campaign to a segment or group of contacts. This allows you to address specific groups of people based on their attributes and activity (e.g. their location, the last time they opened your emails, etc). This targeted approach can help keeping your recipients engaged.For example, if you create a segment of all contacts who have clicked a link in an email within the last 7 days, you can send only that group a targeted campaign with a special offer, coupon or other incentive.Before you begin:Create your segments and set filters for these segments by clicking the Segments tab in Contacts in your site's dashboard.To send an email campaign to a segment:
Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Create an email campaign or edit an existing one. Customize the elements in your campaign to your liking. 
Tip: Preview and test your email campaign to make sure it is perfect before you add recipients and send. Click Next at the top right. Select Target group under Who are you sending this email to. Click + Add Segment under Segments.  Select the checkbox next to the relevant segments to receive your campaign.  Click Choose Segments.
Tip: If you want to create a new segment with filters for this email campaign, go to the Segments tab in Contacts. (Optional) Add individual contacts to your recipient list who aren't in the segment. Click Next at the top right to publish your email campaign. Edit the sender details of your campaign including the subject line, 'From name' and reply-to email.  Click Send now to send your campaign to the segment. 
Tip: You can also send a test email to see how the campaign appears, or click Schedule to schedule your campaign.Note:Sending an email campaign to a segment counts towards your monthly email marketing balance (both campaign and email limits). You can view all stats in My Email Campaigns.

source_documents.title: Email Marketing: Sending Your Email Campaign
source_documents.content:
Email Marketing: Sending Your Email Campaign
After creating your email campaign, spread the word by sending it to your subscribers. You can schedule your campaign to be sent later, send it right away, or send a test email. In this article, learn more about:
Sending a test email before sending your campaign Scheduling your campaign to be sent later Sending your campaign as soon as possible  Resending your campaign Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Important:Make sure to read the Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use before sending any campaigns.Sending a test email before sending your campaignYou can send a test email to see how your campaign will look and function in a real inbox. This does not affect your monthly email limit. To send a test email:
Create an email campaign or edit an existing one.  Customize the elements in your campaign to your liking, then click Preview & Test. Click Send Test Email. Enter details in the following fields:
    
Send to: Enter the email address you want to send the test email to. You can only send test emails to one recipient at a time. Subject: Enter the subject line of the test email. Sender's name: Enter the name the test email will show as sent from. This may be your business or personal name. Reply-to email: Enter the email address that will appear when you reply to the test email.   Click Send.Notes:
Dynamic values and the Unsubscribe link do not show in test emails, but will appear in the final campaigns you send.  Test emails are sent from no-reply@usrmailtest.com. Elements in your email automatically adjust to look their best on any screen or email inbox.Scheduling an email marketing campaignYou can schedule your campaign to be sent at a later date and time. Make sure to upgrade your plan if you would like to use this feature. Once scheduled, the emails in your campaign count towards your monthly sending limit. You cannot restore this limit by deleting the scheduled campaign.To schedule sending a campaign:
Create an email campaign or edit an existing one. Then click Next. Customize the elements in your campaign to your liking, then click Next.
Tip: Preview and test your email campaign to make sure it is perfect before you add recipients and send. Add recipients to your campaign and click Next. Edit the final sending details:
    
Subject line: Enter the subject line of the emails. You can add dynamic text that automatically adjusts to your contacts' details or your site's URL by clicking + Add Dynamic Value and choosing an option.  Sender details: Enter the Sender's name and Reply-to email. This is the name and email address that recipients the emails will show as sent from and can reply to once they receive the email.
Note: You sender name can be your business or personal name. Email recipients: See an overview of how many people the email will be sent to.    Click Schedule. Select the date and time in which you want the campaign to be sent.
Tip: Check the time zone to make sure your campaign is sent at the right time. If the time zone is incorrect, change it in your browser's settings. Click Schedule.  Tip:You can edit or reschedule your campaign before it is sent. Sending your campaign as soon as possibleOnce you're ready to get the news out about your campaign, send it. Your campaign goes into a queue where it's reviewed before it gets sent. You can then share your campaign wherever else you'd like.To send your email campaign:
Create an email campaign or edit an existing one. Customize the elements in your campaign to your liking, then click Next.
Tip: Preview and test your email campaign to make sure it is perfect before you add recipients and send. Add recipients to your campaign and click Next. Review the final details before sending the campaign:
    
Subject line: Enter the email's subject line. You can add dynamic text that automatically adjusts to your contacts' details / your site's URL by clicking + Add Dynamic Value.  Sender details: View the name and reply-to email address that will appear on your email campaign as the sender. If needed, you click Manage to edit the details. Email recipients: See an overview of how many people the email will be sent to. If needed, you can click Edit to change the recipients.  
Click Send Now.  (Optional) Choose an option to share your campaign: Share on Social or Copy link.
Tip: Learn more about the URL of your published campaigns.   Click Done.What's next?Your campaign gets added to the send queue, where it will be reviewed and sent soon.Sending your campaign againYou can resend an email campaign to any recipients who have not yet opened your email. 24 hours after you send a campaign, a Resend icon  appears next to your campaign stats.Resending a campaign also provides an opportunity to re-engage recipients. Before resending, you can update the subject line to see if more people will interact with the email the second time.Important:
If your email open rate was 100% you will not see this option, as everyone saw your email. Resending a campaign counts towards your monthly balance. If your campaign was created over a year ago, the links in your campaign will no longer work and you will need to regenerate them. To resend your email campaign:
Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click View all Campaigns. Click the Published tab. Hover over the campaign you want and click the Resend icon .
Note: This icon only appears 24 hours after the first campaign was sent to give your recipients time to open when it's convenient for them. Add a subject line for the campaign. Click Send Now. Tips:
This campaign is displayed as a new campaign with the label 're-sent email' in your Email Marketing dashboard. Before sending you can see how many recipients will receive the new campaign, or you can choose to select additional contacts to target. FAQsClick a question below to learn more about sending your email campaign. Why do my email campaigns with a large number of recipients take longer to send? When sending your campaigns to a large number of recipients may still increase the time it takes for all recipients to receive your newsletter. Most campaigns are sent immediately, however, in extreme cases it may take up to 24 hours for all to be sent.What is the Reply-to-Email?The Reply-to email is the email address your subscribers reach when clicking Reply.Do my campaigns get sent from my reply-to email address?The email address your campaign is sent from depends on a few factors.If your reply-to email address is: 
A business email address with your own custom domain: Your campaigns will be sent from the reply-to email address (e.g. sales@mystunningwebsite.com). 
Note: Your business email's domain must be connected to Wix via name servers for the emails to send from your business email. If you connected the domain to Wix via pointing, the emails will be sent from a Wix email address.   A public email address such as @gmail, @yahoo, @outlook: Your campaigns will be sent from a Wix email address such as user@pb01.ascendbywix.com.  Learn more about the Wix email addresses used to send your campaigns.What is email sampling?When you send your campaign to a new list of contacts, Wix may send the emails in batches. If a certain percentage of your emails are bounced or rejected, your campaign will not be sent to the rest of the recipients. This email sampling is done to ensure that you do not damage your sending reputation, in case you send to invalid contacts. Learn more about email sampling.What is email throttling?Email throttling is a part of the email marketing abuse detection system used to prevent spam and harmful campaigns. If the system finds potential issues with your campaign, the rate at which the emails are delivered is slowed down. This deliberate slowdown of email distribution in order to prevent potential spam is known as 'email throttling'. Why did some recipients get removed from my campaign?After sending your email campaign, Wix reviews your list of recipients. Your recipients are automatically removed if emails to them are likely to get marked as spam or bounce back.This automatic removal of recipients is to protect your sender reputation. Why is my campaign in "In Review" status?After sending your email campaign, it can go into an "In Review" status before it is actually sent to your contacts. In this status, your campaign is being checked to make sure it complies with our Email Marketing Terms of Use. This is also to ensure you do not damage your sender reputation. Campaigns in review are usually sent within minutes. However, it can take up to 3 hours to complete the review. If your campaign is still in review after 3 hours, you can contact us to check the reason for the delay. Why am I not receiving my test emails? Here are some common reasons why you might not be receiving your test emails:
Spam Filters: The email service provider receiving your email campaign decides whether or not to mark it as spam. Most email service providers, such as Google and Yahoo have systems in place which automatically scan incoming mail.  Delivery Time: Non compliance with Wix Email Marketing best practices leads at a minimum to a delay in the delivery of your newsletter.  Small Batch Delivery: Webmail providers that deliver in small batches include Yahoo, AOL, and Hotmail. If your sender's email account is hosted at one of these providers, it may take up to 24 hours for your email campaign to be delivered.  DMARC: Several free email service providers like Yahoo and AOL have updated their DMARC policies in an effort to reduce email abuse issues. If you send an email campaign with a Yahoo (including Ymail and RocketMail) or AOL sender's email address, the receiving email provider may reject the newsletter.If you do not receive your test emails, try the following:
Check your spam folder. Send your test to a different email address. If you need further assistance, contact us for help.Why aren't my images displayed in my email campaign?Some mail providers prevent images and multimedia content from appearing directly in the email. These settings are not determined by Wix but by the mail provider receiving the email.

source_documents.title: Google Ads with Wix: About the Google Ads Credit Offer
source_documents.content:
Google Ads with Wix: About the Google Ads Credit Offer
Earn $500 USD (or the currency equivalent) in ad credit directly from Google to help run your Google Ads with Wix campaign. In this article, learn more about:
Eligibility for Google Ads credit Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Eligibility for Google Ads creditIn order to be eligible for the ad credit offer:
You must be new to Google advertising and have not previously run a Google Ads campaign with your site. You must spend $500 USD (or your currency equivalent ) on ad clicks within the first 60 days of your campaign.If you are eligible for this ad credit, Google applies it directly to your available ad credits and you will receive a notification via email as well as in your site's dashboard.This ad credit is not refundable and you must spend it within 60 days of receiving it in your account. Read more about Google's terms and conditions.Tip:Since your ad budget is spent on clicks, you have a better chance of being eligible if you set your monthly subscription to at least $300 USD (around $10 USD per day). FAQsClick a question to learn more about how the Google Ads credit offer works.How long do I have to spend the ad credit after receiving it?You need to spend the ad credit within 60 days of receiving it in your account. After 60 days, the ad credit expires.How do I know if I am eligible to receive this credit?You are eligible for the ad credit as long as you meet the following conditions: 
You are new to Google advertising. You have not run a Google Ads campaign previously with your site. You have spent $500 USD (or your currency equivalent ) on ad clicks in the first 60 days after launching your campaign.Note: If you have run a campaign in the past with Google Ads, you will not be eligible, even if this is your first campaign with Google Ads with Wix.What if I am running a campaign in a currency other than USD?If you are running your campaign in a supported currency other than USD (GBP, EUR, JPY) the ad credit breakdown is as follows:
GBP: Spend 400 GBP within the first 60 days to receive 400 GBP ad credit. EUR: Spend 400 EUR within the first 60 days to receive 400 EUR ad credit. JPY: Spend 60,000 JPY within the first 60 days to receive 60,000 JPY ad credit.All other currencies which are converted to USD need to spend $500 USD to receive the $500 USD ad credit.How is the ad credit applied to my account?After you have spent $500 USD within the first 60 days, Google automatically applies the amount to your available ad credits. You will receive an email about the new credit, as well as a dashboard notification.Does turning off auto-renewal of my subscription affect the credit?No, if you turn off auto-renewal your Google Ads credit is not affected. For example, if you purchase a $1K subscription and then turn off auto-renewal, you can still receive the credit as long as you spend $500 within the first 60 days.Why am I not seeing the credit immediately?Purchasing a Google Ads with Wix subscription does not apply the credit immediately. The promotional credit is applied to your account after you spend $500 USD on ad clicks. Then it is applied to your account.Note: Since the credit comes directly from Google, it may take a few days to see the credit applied to your account after you have fulfilled the requirements.

source_documents.title: Hopp by Wix: Upgrading to a Pro Plan
source_documents.content:
Hopp by Wix: Upgrading to a Pro Plan
Upgrade your Hopp by Wix account to a Pro plan to enjoy lots of extra features. With Hopp Pro, you can connect a custom domain and remove the Hopp branding from your Link in Bio page to really make it your own. The Pro plan also unlocks advanced design options and useful creator tools like Short Links, Pre-Rolls and Instant Pages.What is included when I upgrade to a Pro plan? Firstly, you get to personalize the Link in Bio page even more:
Connect a custom domain. Remove the Hopp branding (e.g. the ad banner). Access advanced layout and design options (e.g. extra fonts, button styles, list types). Show a verified account badge.
You also get access to these useful tools, alongside the option to track their performance: 
Short Links: Shorten and rebrand links you want to share with your followers. Pre-Rolls: Show your followers a promotion whenever they click a link on your page.   Instant Pages: Instantly create and publish pages with the content you want to share.Lastly, if you have a Wix site, a Pro plan lets you sync contact data seamlessly between your site and Hopp. For example, contacts that you collect via Hopp would automatically appear on your Wix site's contact list.In this article, learn more about: 
Upgrading to a Hopp Pro plan Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Upgrading to a Hopp Pro planWhen you upgrade to Hopp Pro, you get access to many features and benefits to help you take your Link in Bio page to the next level. You can choose whether you want to be billed monthly or yearly.  To upgrade to a Pro plan: 
Go to hopp.co and log in.  Click Upgrade at the top right. 


 Select the type of plan you want to purchase:
    
Monthly: You will be billed once monthly. Yearly: You will be billed once annually, at a discounted price.   Click Upgrade to confirm. Enter your payment method details and click Submit Payment. Click Get Started to being using your Pro features.FAQsClick a question below to learn more about Hopp by Wix Pro plans. I've already upgraded my Wix site. Do I need to purchase a Hopp Pro plan?Yes. The Hopp Pro plans are separate from the Wix plans. If you'd like to benefit from the Hopp Pro features, you'll need to purchase a monthly or yearly plan. How can I cancel my Hopp Pro plan auto-renewal? If you wish to cancel your Hopp Pro plan, you can do so by following the steps: 
Go to hopp.co and log in.  Click Settings on the left. Click Manage on Wix under Manage Hopp Plan.  Click the More Actions icon  next to your Hopp plan.  Click Cancel Hopp.
