source_documents.title: Wix Blog: Creating and Editing Blog Posts in the Wix App
source_documents.content:
Wix Blog: Creating and Editing Blog Posts in the Wix App
With the Wix app, you can stay productive on the go and keep your blog updated from anywhere, anytime. Using the app, you can choose to create new blog posts or edit existing posts. In this article, learn more about:
Creating a blog post Editing a blog postCreating a blog post in the Wix appCreate a new blog post anytime and from anywhere with the Wix app. New posts that you create in the app are automatically added to your site.To create a blog post:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Blog. Tap + Create New Post.
Enter your post title and post.   (Optional) Add formatting or tap the Add icon  at the bottom to add a block such as an image, gallery, video and more. Tap Next at the top right. Tap Post Settings. Tap each tab at the top to customize the settings available: 
    
General: Edit the publish date, select the writer, add an excerpt of your post, and more. Categories: Select the relevant category for your post, or create a new category. Tags: Tap the relevant tag to add it to your post.  SEO: Edit the post URL, add the post title, and describe what the post is about.    Tap Save at the top right and choose to do one of the following: 
    
Save changes: Changes are saved, ready to be published at a later stage.  Schedule: Changes are saved and scheduled to be published on a specific date and time. Save & Publish: Changes are saved and published straight away.   Editing a blog post in the Wix appNeed to make a change to a blog post while you're on the go? The Wix app on your mobile device lets you edit blog drafts and published posts directly from your phone.To edit a blog post in the Wix app:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Blog. Tap Posts. Tap the post you want to edit.
Note: If the post has not yet been published, tap Drafts at the top and then tap the post.
Make your changes and then tap Next at the top right.  Tap Save & Publish.

source_documents.title: Wix Blog: Creating and Managing Blog Categories
source_documents.content:
Wix Blog: Creating and Managing Blog Categories
Categories are a great way to sort your blog into different topics and give your readers a general idea what your blog posts are about. Once you've set up your categories, you'll be able to display them on your blog pages as a category menu. You can also set post feeds to display specific categories.In this article:
Creating blog categories Assigning posts to a category Reordering categories Deleting a category Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Creating blog categoriesCreate categories for each of the topics your blog covers. Your can assign posts to more than one category (up to 10 per post) so you have the freedom to divide your posts however you want. Give your categories easily understandable titles and descriptions so readers know what to expect.To create a category:
Go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Click New Category.
Note: Your blog comes with a few default categories, click Edit to customize one. Enter the category details:
    
Category Label: The label appears on your blog menu and at the bottom of blog posts in this category. Make sure to keep it short and informative.  Category URL Slug: This is the URL of the blog category which readers can see in the browser bar (and use to access the category directly). By default, it takes the category label as the slug (end of the URL), but you can edit it if you need to.  Note:The URL slug must be at least two characters long and can't have more than one slash.  For example, you can change the slug to recipes/vegetables, but you cannot change it to recipes/vegetables/tomatoes


Enter the SEO and social sharing settings of the category.  This info appears in search engines and when you share the category on social media.
    
Category title: Enter a title that describes your category. It does not have to be the same as the category label. Category description: Enter a description for the category so readers know what to expect when they find your category on Google or see it shared on social media. Category image: Adding an image is optional, this image appears when you share the category on social media.   Click Save.Tip:You can also create a new category as you're creating your blog post. Click the Categories tab on the left of any blog post to assign and create new categories.Assigning posts to categoriesYou can assign posts to categories while you're writing the post, or you can come back to the Post Composer later to add it to categories. To assign posts to categories:
Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Select the post that you want to edit, or click Create New Post to add a new one. Select the categories you want to assign the post to. (Up to 10 categories). 
Tip: Click Create Category to create a new category.  Click Publish. Reordering your categoriesYour categories appear in the category menu and feed in the order that you create them. You can change this order by dragging them up and down the list on the Categories tab.To reorder your categories:
Go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Click and drag the handle to move the categories up or down.Deleting a categoryYou can delete categories if you no longer need them. Deleting a category does not delete the posts inside it. The posts still appear under All Posts and any other categories they were assigned to.To delete a category:
Go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Hover over a category and click the More Actions icon.  Click Delete. Click Delete to confirm.FAQsHow do I rename the "All Posts" category?The "All Posts" category holds all of your blog posts, regardless of which categories they were assigned to. You can rename this category to change it on the blog menu.
To change the title of the "All Posts" category:
Go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Click Rename next to All Posts. Enter a new title and click Save.How do I change my "main" category?Although a post can belong to more than one category, it only appears with a single category label on your blog feed. This label is the "main" category.To change the "main" category:
Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Do one of the following:
    
Click Create new post. Click Edit to edit an existing post.    Click the Categories tab in the panel on the left.  Click the checkbox next to the relevant category.  Click Set as main. Some of my categories are missing, why can't I see them?You can create as many categories as you want, however in some places, there is a limit to how many you can see:
Dashboard: You can see (and create) up to 100 categories from the Categories tab in your site's dashboard.  Category label drop-down: You can see up to 30 categories on the category label drop-down (where you select a category for a blog post) Category menu: You can display up to 50 categories on the blog menu.Can I create subcategories?Currently, it is not possible to create subcategories in Wix Blog. Click here to vote for this feature.

source_documents.title: Wix Bookings: Managing Email Notifications You Send to Clients
source_documents.content:
Wix Bookings: Managing Email Notifications You Send to Clients
With Wix Bookings, you can also choose which email notifications to send to your clients. Whether it's a confirmation email, a reminder, or a follow-up, you have full control over the types of messages that your clients receive. You can also create automations to customize your automated emails even more.In this article, learn more about:
Editing the default booking confirmation email Disabling default booking confirmation emails What your clients see when they book servicesEditing the default booking confirmation emailEditing your confirmation email is a great way to welcome clients to your business. You can add a personal touch to make the message fit your brand. To edit your default confirmation emails:
Go to the Booking Settings tab.  Click Emails & SMS notifications. Click Edit next to Send clients an email confirmation when they book.  Click the relevant tab to choose the service type: Appointments or Classes & courses (Optional) Enable the Email video conferencing link toggle to add a video conferencing link to this email. Choose which field to edit:
    
Subject: Customize the email subject line to entice your clients to open it.  Message: Edit the text of the email to include any information your clients need to know before attending.   (Optional) Click Send Test Email to send yourself a preview of the email. Click Save.Notes:
The confirmation emails you receive display your business's time zone. The emails you send to your clients display the time zone they select. Test emails display ${priceText} and $12.34 as the service price and total. This will not appear in your actual confirmation emails.Disabling default booking confirmation emailsYou can disable the default booking confirmation emails at any time. This can be useful if you set up custom automated emails and don't want to overwhelm your clients. Note:Make sure you have some method of informing clients that their booking is confirmed before disabling the default booking confirmation emails. To disable the booking confirmation emails
Go to the Booking Settings tab. Click Emails & SMS notifications. Click to disable the toggle next to Confirmation Email.What your clients see when they book servicesWix sends your clients confirmation emails when they book one of your services. Depending on which method you chose above, the email shows as plain text or includes things like your company logo and additional graphics. Important:If your clients book a service and there is a delay or failure in processing their payment, you receive an email to let you know.



When this happens with online services, the confirmation email your client receives will not include a Zoom link to the service. Instead, you can send the link manually from your Booking Calendar once the payment is completed by clicking the session in the calendar and clicking Copy link.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Designing Your Gallery
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Designing Your Gallery
Customize your gallery design at any time, without having to re-add your images. You can explore different gallery types, choose from a variety of presets and refine the design for the desired look and feel. In this article, learn more about:
Switching to a different gallery type Customize the gallery's designSwitching to a different gallery typeAfter adding a gallery, you can always change the design to a preset that showcases your images better. Choose a traditional grid layout or a Slider that lets visitors navigate at their own pace. We also offer more creative layouts like a 3D Carousel, Honeycomb and Freestyle. To change your gallery type:
Click the gallery in your editor. Click the Design icon . Browse the available designs and select the one you like. Customizing your gallery designOnce you've chosen the gallery type you like best, you can click Customize Design and start personalizing it. Choose from a range of gallery presets and adjust settings like the shape of your images, the border and shadow around them, or even the font (if your gallery features text). To customize your gallery design:
Click the gallery in your editor. Click the Design icon . Click Customize Design. Customize the gallery using the options available:Customize specific design settingsEach gallery type offers further customization. The options available depend on the gallery type and design preset you choose.To customize specific design settings:
Click an option below the design presets in the Gallery Design panel. Customize the options available to suit your needs.
Tip: Learn more about the design options available across galleries

Tip:The design options differ depending on the gallery type, as well as the preset you choose in Gallery Design. For example, some galleries have the option to customize the regular and hover view.Note:While you can adjust some layout settings, it is not possible to customize your gallery design in the mobile editor.

source_documents.title: Wix Media: Organizing the Files in Your Media Manager
source_documents.content:
Wix Media: Organizing the Files in Your Media Manager
Organizing your files helps you save time and stay efficient when looking for specific media. Keep your files in your Media Manager organized by sorting them into different folders and sub-folders, so you can avoid sifting through irrelevant files.Make finding your files easier by narrowing your file search through filters, reordering your files, and adjusting the layout of your Media Manager. Use Boards to create account-level folders to easily access your media files across all your sites. In this article, learn more about:
Filtering files by file type Creating a folder Move a file to a folder Save a file to your Boards Renaming a file or folder Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Filtering files by file typeFilter your files by file types to find them more easily in the Media Manager. You can view your files in a list or gallery format and customize the order in which files are displayed.To filter your files:Wix EditorStudio EditorWix app
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Find the files you need in the following ways:
    
Click the Media Types icon  below the search bar. Then, select the checkbox next to the relevant file type(s). Click the Reorder list icon  to adjust how your files are displayed (Last Modified or Name):
        
Last Modified: Descending shows the files last worked on at the top of the list. Ascending shows your oldest modified files at the top of the list. Name: Display your files in alphabetical order or from Z-A.   Click the Change layout icon  to switch between the Gallery and List view:
        
Gallery: Your media is displayed as thumbnails. List: Your media is displayed in a list.     
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Site Files on the left. Find the files you need in the following ways:
    
Click the Media Types icon  below the search bar. Then, select the checkbox next to the relevant file type(s). Click the Reorder list icon  to adjust how your files are displayed (Last Modified or Name):
        
Last Modified: Descending shows the files last worked on at the top of the list. Ascending shows your oldest modified files at the top of the list. Name: Display your files in alphabetical order or from Z-A.   Click the Change layout icon  to switch between the Gallery and List view:
        
Gallery: Your media is displayed as thumbnails. List: Your media is displayed in a list.     
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings.  Tap Media Manager. Tap Site media. Find the files you need in the following ways:
    
Tap Sort by: Newest and find the files you need in the following ways:
        
Choose how to sort the files: Newest, Oldest, File name: A-Z, or File name: Z-A. Select the checkbox next to the relevant file type(s).   Tap the More Actions icon  to switch between the grid and list view:
        
Change to grid view: Your media is displayed as thumbnails. Change to list view: Your media is displayed in a list.    Creating a folderOrganize your Media Manager into folders so that you can easily find what you are looking for.To create a folder in your Media Manager:Wix EditorStudio EditorWix app
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Click Create New Folder. Type the name of the new folder. Press Enter on your keyboard. (Optional) Double-click the folder and click Create New Folder to create a sub-folder.Tips:
Click Upload Media or drag files into the new folder to add media. Hover over the folder and click the More Actions icon  to add the folder to your Favorites, rename it, copy it and more.
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Site Files on the left. Click Create New Folder. Type the name of the new folder. Press Enter on your keyboard. (Optional) Double-click the folder and click Create New Folder to create a sub-folder.Tips:
Click Upload Media or drag files into the new folder to add media. Hover over the folder and click the More Actions icon  to add the folder to your Favorites, rename it, copy it and more.
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings.  Tap Media Manager. Tap Site media. Tap + Add and tap Create folder. Type the name of the new folder. Tap Create. (Optional) Create a sub-folder.
    
Tap the folder. Tap + Add. Tap Create folder. Type the name of the new folder. Tap Create.  Tips:
Tap + Add to add media from your mobile device. Tap the More Actions icon  under a file to rename it, copy it, and more.Moving a file to a folderAfter creating folders in your Media Manager, move files to the relevant folder for a clean and organized look.To move a file to a folder in the Media Manager:Wix EditorStudio EditorWix app
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Hover over the relevant file and click the More Actions icon . Click Move to....  Select the folder where you want to move your media or click Create New Folder.  Click Move Here.
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Site Files on the left. Hover over the relevant file and click the More Actions icon . Click Move to....  Select the folder where you want to move your media or click Create New Folder.  Click Move Here.Tip:Drag and drop a file into a folder or use the cut and paste command to move your files quickly. 
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings.  Tap Media Manager. Tap Site media. Tap the More Actions icon  under the relevant file. Scroll down and tap Move. Select the folder where you want to move your media or tap Create new folder. Tap Move here.Move multiple files at once:Tap the More Actions icon  at the top right, tap Select, and mark multiple files. Then tap the Move icon  at the bottom and select the folder where you want to move the files.Saving a file to your BoardsUse Boards to create account-level folders to easily access your media files across all your sites.To save a file to your Boards:Wix EditorStudio EditorWix app
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Hover over the relevant file and click the More Actions icon . Hover over Add to Board. Click Add next to the Board where you want to add your media or click New Board.Tip:Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon  to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Site Files on the left. Hover over the relevant file and click the More Actions icon . Hover over Add to Board. Click Add next to the Board where you want to add your media or click New Board.Tip:Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon  to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings.  Tap Media Manager. Tap Site media. Tap the More Actions icon  under the relevant file. Scroll down and tap Add to a board. Tap the Board where you want to add your media or tap Create New Board.Add multiple files to a Board:Tap the More Actions icon  at the top right, tap Select, and mark multiple files. Then tap the Add to a board icon  at the bottom and select the Board where you want to add your media.Renaming a file or folderYou may want to change the name of your media files and folders to accurately reflect their content, so you can easily find them later on.To rename a file or folder:Wix EditorStudio EditorWix app
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Hover over the relevant file or folder and click the More Actions icon . Click Rename. Type the file or folder's new name. Press Enter on your keyboard.Tip:Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon  to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
Go to the editor. Click Media  on the left side of the editor. Click Site Files on the left. Hover over the relevant file or folder and click the More Actions icon . Click Rename. Type the file or folder's new name. Press Enter on your keyboard.Tip:Click the Add to My Favorites Board icon  to automatically add the file to the My Favorites folder.
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings.  Tap Media Manager. Tap Site media. Tap the More Actions icon  under the relevant file or folder. Tap Rename. Type the file or folder's new name. Tap Save.FAQsClick a question below to learn more about organizing your files in your Media Manager:Can I sort my files by numerical order?No. Currently, it is not possible to sort files, with names consisting of digits, in numerical order. The Media Manager sorts files by the first digit listed, meaning files are sorted as such: 1, 100, 11, 12, 13, 130... 20, 200, 21. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for this feature.Can I sort my files in a non-case-sensitive manner?No. Currently, it is not possible to sort files in a non-case-sensitive manner in the Media Manager. Files whose names begin with a capital letter are listed first, followed by files whose names begin with a lower case letter. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for this feature.Can I download all folders in my Site Files at once?No. Currently, it is not possible to select multiple files and folders at once from Site Files in the Media Manager in order to download all your media in zip format. Multiple files within each folder can be selected and downloaded together, but each folder must be opened individually in order to choose and download the selected media. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for this feature.

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Creating a Sale Price Coupon
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Creating a Sale Price Coupon
Encourage customers to make purchases by offering a sale price coupon (e.g. all posters are now $20). In this article, learn more about:
Creating a sale price coupon Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Creating a sale price couponAfter you give your coupon a name and set a price, you can choose exactly when it's valid, what products it can be applied to, and more. To create a sale price coupon:
Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard. Click + New Coupon. Select Sale Price.
Enter the Coupon code customers need to enter. Enter the Coupon name. 
Note: This name appears in the cart page and your site's dashboard. Enter the sale price under Now Only. This is the price your customers pay. Select an option from the Apply to drop-down:
    
All products: Applies to all products (customer can apply it to multiple products). Specific product: Applies to one product. Click the Product drop-down and select the product. Specific category: Applies to all products in a category (customer can apply it to multiple products). Click the Category drop-down and select the category.   (Optional) Select the Include subscriptions checkbox to apply this coupon to product subscriptions.
Note: Applies to every cycle (e.g. every month of a monthly subscription). Make sure the coupon value isn't greater than the subscription price. Select when the coupon is valid:
    
Enter the start date. Enter the end date, or select the Don't set an end date checkbox.   (Optional) Select the checkboxes next to the limits you want to apply:
    
Limit the total number of uses for this coupon: Enter the total number of times the coupon can be used.
Tip: Multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually. Limit to one use per customer: Each customer can use the coupon only once.   Click Create Coupon.FAQsClick a question below to learn more about coupons.How can I apply a coupon to a group of products?To apply a coupon to a group of products, create a new category and add all the relevant products. No need to display this category on your site. How are coupons applied to product subscriptions?When you select the Include subscriptions checkbox, and a customer uses a coupon to purchase a subscription, the discount applies each cycle. This means that if a customer buys a monthly subscription that lasts 12 months, the customer gets a discount for each of the 12 purchases.Why isn't the promo code visible on the cart page?The promo code may not be visible because you hid it or because the text color blends in with the background color. To unhide the promo code link:
Access the store pages in your Editor:
    
Wix Editor: 
        
Click Pages and Menuon the left side of the Editor. Click Store Pages.   Editor X: 

Click Pages  at the top of Editor X.  Scroll down to Store Pages.     Click Cart Page. Click anywhere on the cart page.  Click Settings.  Click the Settings tab. Make sure the Promo code link checkbox is selected. To change the promo code text color:
Access the store pages in your Editor:
    
Wix Editor: 
        
Click Pages and Menuon the left side of the Editor. Click Store Pages.   Editor X: 

Click Pages  at the top of Editor X.  Scroll down to Store Pages.     Click Cart Page. Click anywhere on the cart page.  Click Settings. Click the Design tab. Scroll down to Links and select a color that contrasts with the page background.

Are coupon codes case sensitive?No, coupon codes are not case sensitive. Customers can enter your codes without using the same case.For purchases with the manual payment method, when does the number of available coupons update?If you limited your coupon use to a set number (e.g. available for the first 100 shoppers), every time a coupon is used, it's counted. When a customer pays you offline, the coupon count is updated once you mark the order as paid. How can I promote or share my coupon?Use the Promote link to easily create an email marketing campaign or social post for any of your coupons.To promote your coupon:
Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon  next to the relevant coupon. Select Promote. Select a promotion option:
    
Send a social media marketing post. Send an email marketing campaign.  Can I create a coupon with unique coupon codes for each use?Yes. You can use the Bulk Coupon Creator app to generate up to 1000 unique codes per coupon.Can I offer discounts without coupon codes?Yes, you can also offer products at a sale price or provide automatic discounts. Can I create coupons for things other than store products?Yes. You can create coupons for:
Wix Bookings Wix Events Pricing Plans

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Delivering Digital Products
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Delivering Digital Products
Digital products are downloadable files such as music files, illustrations, images, or ebooks.Important:Taxation regulations for digital goods vary by location. Check with your local tax authority to see what taxes apply.In this article, learn more about:
Delivering digital files Resending digital filesDelivering digital filesWhen you sell a digital product, the file is delivered to your customer as soon as the payment is received.
Immediate payment received: As soon as you receive online payment (e.g. credit card, PayPal, etc.), a confirmation email is sent to the customer with a download link. The link also appears on the Thank You page. Delayed payment: When payment does not arrive immediately (e.g. manual payment or echeck), a download link is not included in the confirmation email. After you receive payment and manually mark the order as Paid, a second email is sent to your customer with the download link.Sales with both digital and physical products:A sale that includes digital and physical products is marked as fulfilled only after the physical products are shipped. Resending digital filesThe download link sent to customers is active for 30 days. After that, it no longer works. You can resend a file to your customer at any time.To resend a digital file:
Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click to select the relevant order. Click the More Actions icon . Click Resend Download Link.

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Selling Product Subscriptions
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Selling Product Subscriptions
Selling product subscriptions online is the perfect way to create a steady income stream while making life easy for your customers. You can offer a product only as a subscription, or let your customers choose what's right for them: A one-time purchase or one of your subscription options. Important:To sell product subscriptions, you must connect a payment method that supports recurring payments. In this article, learn more about:
Creating product subscriptions Fulfilling product subscriptions FAQsCreating a product subscription
Go to Products in your site's dashboard.  Create a new physical product or edit an existing one. Scroll down and click Create a Subscription. Enter a name.
Tip: The name appears on the Product Page.
(Optional) Enter a tagline. 
Tip: The tagline appears on the product page.
Select how often the a new order is created (e.g. once every 2 months):
    
Use the up and down arrows to select a number. Select a time unit (day, month, or year).  
Click the Expires after drop-down and choose when the subscription ends:
    
Preset option: Click to select one of the available options. Create a custom expiration time:  Select Custom and enter the number of billing cycles  before the subscription expires.   (Optional) Offer a discount off the regular price:
    
Select the discount type (price or percentage). Enter the discount amount.
Tip: The price per week / month / year adjusts accordingly. Alternatively, you can enter the price and the discount adjust accordingly.   Click Apply. (Optional) Click +New Subscription to create an additional subscription option (max. 6 subscription options). (Optional) Click and drag the subscription options (if there are more than one) to reorder them. Select how you offer this product: 
    
By subscription only: Clients can't make a one-time purchase. By subscription and for one-time purchase: Clients can choose between a one-time purchase or a subscription.  
Click Save.
Fulfilling product subscriptionsAfter a customer purchases a subscription, a new order appears in your Orders tab. Then, every subscription period, an additional order appears in the tab. For example, if your customer purchased a monthly subscription, an order appears every month for you to fulfill.When you look at an individual order, you can see that it's part of a subscription. Click View Subscription to view and manage the entire subscription.FAQsWhat products cannot be sold as product subscriptions?Product subscriptions cannot be created for digital products.Additionally, some payment providers place restrictions on the type of products that can be sold (e.g. restriction on CBD products). For more information, check with your chosen payment provider.How can I edit, hide, or delete a subscription option?To edit, hide, or delete a subscription option, click the More Actions icon  next to the option and choose what you want to do.How can I change payment providers if customers have already purchased plans?If you choose to switch payment providers, you must first cancel all active subscriptions, switch providers, and then ask your clients to repurchase the same product subscription.What happens if I make changes to the details of a subscription?If you make changes to a plan which customers already purchased, the changes only affect new purchases. So if a customer purchases a subscription and it is set to auto-renew indefinitely, it isn't possible to change the price, tax, or shipping rate for that customer. Can customers checkout with a subscription product and another product?No, it's not possible for customers to buy a product subscription and another product at the same time.Can I create a free subscription?No, it's not possible to offer a product for free as a subscription. How can customers use coupons to buy a subscription?By default, coupons aren't applied to subscription products. When creating a coupon, you can, however, select the Include subscriptions checkbox to apply them. When you do so, and a customer uses a coupon to purchase a subscription, the discount applies each cycle (e.g. for a 12-month subscription, the customer gets a discount for 12 months).What happens if the product is out of stock when it's time for the next cycle of a customer's  subscription?If the product is out of stock when the next subscription cycle occurs, the order is still created.In other words, if a subscription customer has an order is created at the 1st of every month, an order is still created on June 1st even if your inventory status that day is zero.Note: The order pushes your stock into negative numbers.  Is it possible to reactivate a product subscription after it was canceled? No, the customer has to purchase the subscription again.Want to learn more?Check out the full course in Wix Learn on building your store or skip to the video on selling product subscriptions.

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Upgrading Your Site's Plan
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Upgrading Your Site's Plan
You can add and set up Wix Stores on your site for free, but in order for customers to place orders, you must upgrade your site to a plan that allows you to receive payments. This allows you to connect a domain to your site and start selling.Dig deeper:
Learn more about upgrading to a Premium plan. If you're using Wix Studio, learn more about upgrading to a Studio plan.To upgrade your site:
If you have not already done so, add Wix Stores to your site. Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Upgrade icon.
Click Select under the plan you want to purchase. Select a subscription period and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details. Click Submit Purchase. Refresh your editor to see the upgrade applied to your site.Important:After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

source_documents.title: Wix Studio: Buying Studio Templates in the Wix Marketplace
source_documents.content:
Wix Studio: Buying Studio Templates in the Wix Marketplace
Browse our collection of Studio templates in the Wix Marketplace, built by Wix Partners. Preview how each template looks and feels on different devices and get detailed information from the seller. Once you find the perfect fit, purchase the template, and customize it to suit your business needs.Notes:
The Studio Editor is our professional design platform, and editing on it requires advanced knowledge. Learn more about the Studio Editor. Templates in the Marketplace are currently not available for purchases in Israel.In this article, learn more about:
Buying Studio templates Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Buying Studio templates in the Wix MarketplaceBrowse, preview, and purchase a professionally designed Studio template from the Wix Marketplace, perfect for your website.Before you begin:
Studio plans are not included with templates.  Some templates might include apps that require additional payment.To buy a Studio template:
Go to the Studio Templates page in the Wix Marketplace. Browse the Studio templates and click on the one you'd like to purchase.
Tip: Click View Template to preview the template and use the device icons at the top to switch views. Click Purchase. Complete the checkout process and click Continue.  Review your details and click Place Order to confirm. Click Add to Sites to start using your template.  FAQsClick a question below to learn more about buying a Studio template from the Wix Marketplace.Can I use the template for multiple websites?No. A purchased template is licensed for use on a single website. For multiple sites, you would need to purchase additional templates.What information can I get from the seller about a Studio template?Sellers provide detailed information about their template and the features included. You can contact the seller directly if you have specific questions.Can I customize the Studio template after purchasing it?Yes, you can fully customize your purchased Studio template to fit your business and preferences. Use the Studio Editor to change layouts, colors, fonts, images, and more.What if I need help with my template?If you need assistance with your template, you can reach out directly to the seller for support or explore the Wix Help Center.How do I report an issue with a template?If you encounter an issue with a template that hasn’t been resolved by the seller, you can report it directly to Wix. Make sure you're logged into your Wix account before reporting the template.To report a template:
Go to the template page in the Wix Marketplace. Click Report this template at the bottom right.  Enter the following details:
    
Type of issue: Select the relevant issue with the template. Describe the issue: Provide more information about the issue you're experiencing.   (Optional) Select the I agree to be contacted for additional details checkbox. Click Submit Report.Note: You don't need to purchase the template to report it. Your report will be reviewed by our team, and if necessary, the template may be removed from the Marketplace. The seller will not see your report or have access to your personal information.How often are new Studio templates added to the Wix Marketplace?New Studio templates are regularly added to the Wix Marketplace, so check back often to see the latest designs and offerings from Wix Partners.

source_documents.title: About TTL
source_documents.content:
About TTL
Time to live (TTL) is the value of time that tells servers how long to store a DNS record locally before discarding. You should leave the TTL for your DNS records set to the default time.Important:Changing a TTL value does not speed up the time it takes for a DNS record to propagate. It only changes the amount of time before your computer is forced to make a new DNS request.

source_documents.title: Adding and Setting Up the Countdown Clock App
source_documents.content:
Adding and Setting Up the Countdown Clock App
Add the Wix Countdown Clock app to your site and draw attention to your upcoming event. You can change the clock's design to suit your brand, and choose a message to appear after the countdown ends.Step 1 | Add the Countdown Clock app to your siteYou can find the Countdown Clock app in the Wix App Market. Go to the App Market in your editor to add it to your site.Wix EditorStudio Editor
Click Add Apps   on the left side of the editor. Search for the Countdown Clock app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.
Click App Market  on the left side of the editor. Search for the Countdown Clock app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.Step 2 | Set up your countdown clockSelect the type of countdown you want to show, choose a time and date for your countdown to end, and customize the message visitors see when it ends.To set up your countdown clock:
Select the Countdown Clock in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Select countdown type drop-down and select an option:
    
Fixed: Your countdown clock runs once, until a specific date and time. Enter the end date and select your time zone. Repeats: Your countdown clock runs multiple times, i.e. every day, week or month. Select when your clock restarts, enter start and end times and select your time zone. Set per visitor: Your countdown is specific to the visitor that's seeing it and starts when the visitor lands on the page. Choose the unit of time you want to use and the duration of the countdown.   Click the End Message tab. Click the Show message toggle to enable or disable it:
    
Enabled: A message appears to show that the special event or sale has ended. 
Note: You can click the text box in the app widget to change the text that is displayed.
 Disabled: The clock remains at 00:00:00:00 and no message is displayed.  Step 3 | Customize the look of your countdown clockThe Countdown Clock app is fully customizable. You can choose which elements you want to show (e.g. titles, buttons), change the layout or customize the colors and fonts used.Wix EditorStudio Editor
Click the Countdown Clock app in your editor. Choose what you want to customize:
    
Elements: Click the Elements icon   and select which elements you want to show (title text and/or button). Layout: Click the Layout icon  and select a layout for your countdown clock. Drag the slider to change the spacing of the message that appears when the countdown ends. Design: Click the Design icon  to customize the colors and fonts used on your countdown clock.  
Click the Countdown Clock app in your editor. Choose what you want to customize:
    
Elements: Click the Elements icon   and select which elements you want to show (title text and/or button). Layout: Click the Layout icon  and select a layout for your countdown clock. Drag the slider to change the spacing of the message that appears when the countdown ends.
 Design: Click the Open Inspector icon  at the top right of the editor and go to the Design tab. Customize the design using the options available.

source_documents.title: CMS Request: Attaching a Repeater onto Another Repeater
source_documents.content:
CMS Request: Attaching a Repeater onto Another Repeater
Currently, it is not possible to attach a repeater onto another repeater. This feature would allow you to group items within a repeater based on a reference field. For example, you would be able to group dishes within the main repeater by meal (e.g. breakfast, lunch, or dinner).Learn how to connect a repeater to your CMS collection to display dynamic content. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

source_documents.title: CMS Request: Dynamic Text Input Option for Custom Forms
source_documents.content:
CMS Request: Dynamic Text Input Option for Custom Forms
Currently, it is not possible to let your visitors add extra text input fields to a custom form on your site.You can create a custom form on your page with user input elements that include text boxes, radio buttons, upload buttons, and text input. However, this form only displays the input elements you add to the page. It is not possible for your visitors to add extra fields if they need them, e.g. for adding additional instructions that are not covered by the form.We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

source_documents.title: Editor X: Using Lightboxes
source_documents.content:
Editor X: Using Lightboxes
Lightbox popups are a great tool when you need to grab your visitors' attention and drive them into action. Customize your lightbox for different breakpoints to make it effective on any screen size. Then,  create an overlay around it so that visitors can focus on the message it promotes. In this article, learn how to:
Add a lightbox Edit a lightbox Set triggers for a lightbox Link elements to a lightbox Manage lightboxesAdding a LightboxThere are different types of lightboxes that you can choose from and add to your page: 
A center lightbox that appears in the middle of the page. A side bar lightbox that appears on the left or right of the page. A full-width banner at the top or bottom of the page.To add a lightbox:
Click the Add icon  at the top left of the Editor. Click Layout Tools. Click Lightboxes. Select the lightbox you need to add it to your page. Editing a LightboxYou can access your site's lightboxes from the Pages panel. Select the relevant lightbox to enter Editing mode, where you can set it up, design it and add more elements.  Customize your lightboxes per breakpoint:Make sure that your lightbox looks great in every viewport by customizing the design per breakpoint. To edit a lightbox:
Click the Pages icon  at the top of the Editor. Select the relevant lightbox on the left. Edit your lightbox by doing the following:
    
Add elements (e.g., text, image, button) from the Add panel.    Click Set Triggers to customize the pages where it appears, the timing and other settings. Learn More Click Set Up Overlay to decide whether visitors can close the popup by clicking the overlay. Click Adjust Grid to choose a different grid layout for the lightbox.  (From the Inspector panel ) Click the Design icon  to change the background color and opacity.    When ready, click Done at the bottom to exit Editing mode. What's next?Preview your site to see your lightbox in action.Setting Triggers for a LightboxSet up your lightbox to make it behave exactly as you need it to. You can either make it appear automatically as visitors enter a page, or only when they click a certain link or button on your site. Note:Your lightbox is displayed once per visitor, on the first relevant page they see.To set up a lightbox:
Click the Pages icon  at the top of the Editor. Select the relevant lightbox on the left.  Click Set Triggers. Enter a name to describe the lightbox. Select the relevant option under Automatically display lightbox on Pages:
    
Yes: The lightbox automatically appears when visitors enter the relevant pages.
        
Click the Which pages is it on? field and select the pages you want the lightbox to appear on. Drag the Delay slider to increase or decrease the time between the page loading and the lightbox appearing.      No: The lightbox does not appear when visitors enter a page. Instead, it's triggered by a button or a link you choose.    When ready, click Done to exit Editing mode.  Note:When choosing to display a Lightbox automatically on a page (see step 5), the Lightbox will appear again once visitors refresh their browser. It's currently not possible to set a Lightbox to appear only once. Click here to vote for this featureLink Elements to a LightboxLink elements such as buttons, text or menu items to your lightboxes. When visitors click the element or menu item, the lightbox appears as a pop-up. To link an element to a lightbox:
Do one of the following:
    
Select to the element that you want to link from and click the Link icon  . Access your menu and click the Link Items icon .    Select Lightbox on the left. Click the Which Lightbox? drop-down menu and select the relevant lightbox. Click Done.Managing LightboxesFrom the Pages panel, you can always access and manage your site's lightboxes. Give your lightbox a name that's easy to recognize, duplicate a lightbox to quickly create a new one or delete lightboxes that you no longer need. To manage your lightboxes:
Click the Pages icon  at the top of the Editor. Hover over the relevant lightbox and click the Show More icon . Manage your lightbox by doing one of the following:Rename a lightbox
Select Rename.  Enter a new name for your lightbox.Tip: You can also double-click a lightbox to rename it. Duplicate a lightbox
Select Duplicate Lightbox. Enter a name for your new lightbox. (Optional) Set up your lightbox's triggers and customize the design. Learn HowDelete a lightbox
Select Delete. Click Delete in the pop-up to confirm.Note: Deleting a lightbox removes it completely from your site.

source_documents.title: Site Members: Assigning a Role to Your Members
source_documents.content:
Site Members: Assigning a Role to Your Members
After creating roles for your Member's Area, you can assign them to your members at any time. Use these roles to grant members with access to exclusive pages, created just for them.  For example, if you have a teaching website, you can create Teacher and Student roles and assign them to your members. You can then make some of your pages accessible to any member (e.g. teachers and students) and restrict other pages to specific members only (e.g. teachers).Learn how to assign a role:
While editing its permissions From the member list From the member's Contact CardBefore you begin:Make sure you have existing roles in your Members Area.Assigning a role while editing its permissionsAs you edit a certain role's settings and permissions, you can also choose which members to assign it to. To assign a role while editing it:
Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard.  Click Manage Member Roles at the top right. Click the relevant role to edit it.  Click the Members tab. Click + Add Members. Select the checkbox next to the member(s) that should have this role.
Tip: You can use the search bar to find a member by their name or email address.   When ready, click Add. Assigning a role from the member listWhile reviewing your site's member list, you can quickly assign or edit someone's role(s). To assign a role from the member list:
Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard.  Click the More Actions icon  next to the relevant member. Click Edit Roles.  Select the checkbox next to the role(s) you want to assign. When ready, click Save.Assigning a role from a member's Contact CardLooking into a specific member's Contact Card? You can quickly assign new roles under the Member Info section. To assign a role from a member's Contact Card:
Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard.  Click the relevant member to open up their Contact Card. (In the Contact Card) Click Add Role / the Edit Roles icon  under Member Info. Select the checkbox next to the role(s) you want to assign. When ready, click Save.

source_documents.title: Spaces App Request: Deleting Your Site from the Spaces by Wix App
source_documents.content:
Spaces App Request: Deleting Your Site from the Spaces by Wix App
When you publish your site, it becomes available for visitors to search and join within the Spaces by Wix app. Currently, it is not possible to remove your site from the Spaces by Wix app.Workarounds:
You can remove your site from appearing in search in the Spaces app. This prevents visitors from joining your site in the Spaces app, but does not remove your site from the Spaces app for visitors who have already joined in the app. You can remove the invite banner that appears on the mobile version of your site and allows visitors to join your site in the Spaces app.   You can enable the Join Approval toggle in Roles & Permissions. This prevents visitors from joining your site in the Spaces app unless you approve them. We are always working to update and improve our products and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

source_documents.title: Wix Blocks Request: Converting Widgets to Plugins
source_documents.content:
Wix Blocks Request: Converting Widgets to Plugins
Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to directly convert an existing widget into a plugin. This means that users must recreate plugins from scratch.This feature would allow users to convert an existing widget into a plugin without needing to completely rebuild it as a plugin. We are always working to update and improve our products and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

source_documents.title: Wix Compatibility with Internet Explorer
source_documents.content:
Wix Compatibility with Internet Explorer
CompatibilityWix no longer supports editing or viewing live sites on IE11.

If you're using Internet Explorer, we recommend that you instead update to the latest version of Microsoft Edge or another supported browser on PC - Chrome or Firefox. Download Microsoft Edge Reasons for Switching to an Updated BrowserWe strongly recommend that you switch to an updated browser version for the following reasons:Security: Microsoft no longer provides security updates for older versions of Internet Explorer, and soon may cease providing security updates for the browser altogether for newer operating systems. **Without critical browser security updates, your PC may become vulnerable to harmful viruses, spyware, and other malicious software which can steal or damage your business data and information.Tech Support: Microsoft no longer provides tech support or fixes for older versions of Internet Explorer and may soon cease to provide support for the browser on newer operating systems.Compliance: Businesses that are governed by regulatory obligations such as HIPAA must ensure that the software they are using is up to date and compliant with these regulations.Lack of ISV Support: Many Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) no longer support Internet Explorer. For example, Office 365 takes advantage of modern web standards and runs best with the latest browser.What browser are you using?Go to www.whatismybrowser.com to find out if your browser is up to date.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: About Your Page Width
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: About Your Page Width
The width of your site is fixed at 980 pixels. This size was chosen to accommodate the majority of site users and ensures compatibility with the many different smart devices being used today (i.e. iPads or tablets).Tip:You can design your site outside of the 980 pixel borders, however we recommend that anything that you add outside of these borders be mainly decorative and not vital content to your visitors' browsing experience.

source_documents.title: Wix Editor: Adding a Link to an Image
source_documents.content:
Wix Editor: Adding a Link to an Image
Add a link to an image to send your visitors to a page address or anchor, web address, email or document.To add a link to an image:
Click the image in your Editor. Click the Settings icon . Click the drop-down menu under When image is clicked. Select A link opens. Under What does it link to? click the Link icon . Enter the link details. Click Done.Tip:You can also click the Link icon  to set up your link, but make sure that you complete steps 1-4 above first.Click here to learn how to link a button to a specific product page in Wix Stores.

source_documents.title: Wix Forms: Saving Your Form Data to Your Contacts
source_documents.content:
Wix Forms: Saving Your Form Data to Your Contacts
When someone fills out a form on your site, a contact is created in your Contact List.With old Wix Forms, some of the submission data is automatically saved but some you need to manually save. If you want data from a specific field in your form to show in your contacts, you must match it with a field in your contact list.Notes:
This feature is only available for old Wix Forms.  In the new Wix Forms, all data for contact fields is automatically saved and it is not possible to collect information for custom fields.In this article, learn how to:
Save form fields to your contact list Add a custom field to your formSaving form fields to your contact listSelect which form fields to save to your contacts, by matching them to fields in your contact list. You can match all form fields at once, to easily view in one place which fields are connected. Alternatively, you can save individual form fields.To save form fields:
Click the form in your editor. Choose what to do:Match all form fields
Click Form Settings. Click the Contacts tab. Click Choose Fields. Click the drop-down next to each form field and select the relevant contact field.
Note: For form fields you don't need to save, select Don't Save. For form fields that don't have an existing match, select Create field and type in a name for a new custom field. Click Save.Match individual form fields
Click the field in your form you want to save to your contacts. Click the Settings icon .  Click the drop-down under Save Field Data to Contacts. Select a field to connect this form field to. 
Note: For form fields you don't need to save, select Don't Save. For form fields that don't have an existing match, select Create field and type in a name for a new custom field.Adding a custom field to your formIf you add a custom field to your Contacts and want to collect this information from your visitors (such as age or hair color), you need to add the relevant field to your form.To add a custom field to your form:
Click the form in your editor. Click Add New Field. Click Contact Fields and scroll until you find your custom field.  Click the Add icon  to add it to your form.Notes:
Form fields can only be saved to contact fields in a relevant format (For example: email addresses to email fields, text to text fields and numbers to number fields).  Some field data cannot be saved to the Contact List. All of these fields' data can be seen in the submission tables, Inbox & email notifications. These fields are:
    
Upload file field Signature field Anti Spam field

source_documents.title: Wix Hotels by HotelRunner: Creating and Managing Your Cancellation and Deposit Policies
source_documents.content:
Wix Hotels by HotelRunner: Creating and Managing Your Cancellation and Deposit Policies
Important:
This article refers to the latest version of Wix Hotels by HotelRunner. We are in the process of releasing Wix Hotels by HotelRunner but it's not available to everyone yet. Sign up for more information about Wix Hotels by HotelRunner and join the beta. For information on the previous version of Wix Hotels, click here. Add your cancellation and deposit policies so your guests can book with confidence and know exactly what to expect. Your deposit policy appears at checkout. Making your policies clear and easy to understand also helps your customer service staff to resolve issues quickly. In this article, learn more about:
Adding your cancellation policies Managing your cancellation policies Adding your deposit policy Managing and disabling your deposit policyAdding your cancellation policiesA clear cancellation policy is important for keeping your hotel as close to capacity as possible.Include everything guests need to know about cancellation before they complete their booking. Make clear how much notice guests need to provide before cancelling to receive a full refund. You can also add your fees for last-minute cancellations.Important:After you create a cancellation policy, make sure you add it to all relevant Rate Plans for the policy to take effect (see steps 10-13 in the following section). To add a cancellation policy:
Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard.  Click Manage Policies next to Cancellation and deposit policies.  Click + Add cancellation policy. Enter the policy name.  Enter a detailed policy description. For example, include the number of days before check-in that you charge a fee for cancellation, the amount due, etc. (Optional) Add a penalty to your cancellation policy:
    
Enable the Add penalty condition toggle.  Enter how many days before the check-in the penalty will be applied in the event of a cancellation.  Choose a cut-off time from the Select time drop-down. For example, 10:00 AM 2 days before check-in.  Choose the Fee type: 

Fixed amount: Enter the fee you charge if the penalty conditions are met.  Percentage: Enter the percentage of the room rate you charge if the penalty conditions are met.    (Optional) Create additional penalty conditions by clicking + Add new penalty condition.    Enable the Activate policy toggle at the bottom to make this policy active on your site.  Click Add Cancellation Policy to confirm. 
Go to Rate Plans under Property Setup in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to the relevant Rate Plan you want to add the cancellation policy to.  Select the relevant cancellation policy from the Cancellation policy drop-down.  Click Save. Managing your cancellation policiesYou can update or deactivate any of your cancellation policies at any time. This is useful during the off-season when you want to attract more guests. Reactivate your stricter policies during high season to help reduce late cancellations.To manage your cancellation policies:
Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard.  Click Manage Policies next to Cancellation and deposit policies. Click the More Actions icon  next to the relevant policy. Click Edit.  Choose what you want to do:
    
Update the policy's details: Change the name and / or description of the policy.  Add a new penalty condition: Create another condition with a different penalty involved.   Remove a penalty condition: Disable the Add penalty condition toggle so it no longer applies.
Note: If you have multiple conditions, click the Remove condition icon  next to the one you want to delete. Deactivate the entire policy: Disable the Activate policy toggle at the bottom. You can reactivate the policy at any time.    Click Save. Adding your deposit policyIf you don't want to charge your guests the full reservation fee upfront, you can add a deposit policy. This can help offset potential losses from late cancellations. To add a deposit policy:
Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard.  Click Manage Policies next to Cancellation and deposit policies. Click Edit next to Deposit policy.  Select the fee type:
    
Fixed amount: Charge a single, fixed deposit per stay.  Percentage: Charge a percentage fee based on the total cost of your guests' stay.  Fixed fee per night: Charge a fixed deposit amount for each night.    Enter the relevant Fee amount based on your choice above.  (Optional) Select the Include tax checkbox to charge guests tax as part of the deposit.  Enable the Activate policy toggle to make this policy active on your site.  Click Save. Managing and disabling your deposit policyYou can update or deactivate your deposit policy at any time. This is useful during the off-season when you want to attract more guests by not charging a deposit. Reactivate your deposit policy during high season to limit losses from no-shows or late cancellations.To manage or disable your deposit policy:
Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard.  Click Manage Policies next to Cancellation and deposit policies. Click Edit next to your Deposit Policy. Choose what you want to do: 
    
Update the fee type: Change the fee amount and / or type.  Deactivate the deposit policy: Disable the Activate policy toggle so it's no longer active on your site.  Add or remove tax: Select or deselect the Include tax checkbox.   Click Save.

source_documents.title: Wix Invoices & Price Quotes Request: Creating a Member Page for Invoices and Price Quotes
source_documents.content:
Wix Invoices & Price Quotes Request: Creating a Member Page for Invoices and Price Quotes

source_documents.title: Wix Pro Gallery: Adding Media to the Gallery
source_documents.content:
Wix Pro Gallery: Adding Media to the Gallery
Showcase image, video and text content side by side in your multimedia Pro Gallery. Upload your own media, add content from the Wix Libraries, and embed videos from YouTube and Vimeo.In this article, learn more about:
Adding media to your gallery Choosing the position of newly added media Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)Adding media to your galleryAdd image, video and text items to your gallery from the Organize Your Gallery window.Note:When adding a video from Vimeo, make sure that your video privacy settings are set to "Anyone can see the video" and the embed settings are set to "Anywhere".To add media items:
Click the Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Manage Media. Click Add Media. Select the media item you want to add and follow the relevant instructions below:Image
Select the image from your Media Manager or click + Upload Media to upload an image from your computer. Click Add to Gallery. Click Done.
Note: We recommend you upload the best possible quality images to your gallery to ensure the best results. Make sure to upload images of at least 2560 X 1440 pixels in resolution. We optimize them to the exact dimensions displayed on the screen, without any loss of quality. Learn more about image optimizationVideo
Select a video option:
    
Upload: Upload your own video:
        
Select the video in your Media Manager or click Upload Media to upload a video from your computer. Click Add to Gallery.   YouTube: Embed a video from YouTube:
        
Enter the video's web address. Click Add Video.
Note: When adding your own video from YouTube, make sure that your video is set to Public, and the Allow Embedding box is checked.   Vimeo: Embed a video from Vimeo:
        
Enter the video's web address. Click Add Video.
Note: When adding a video from Vimeo, make sure that your video privacy settings are set to Anyone can see the video, and the embed settings are set to Anywhere.     Click Done.
Text
Enter your text in the content window. Format the text using the options available in the top bar. Customize the text using the following options:
    
Layout: Choose a layout for the text: Square, Horizontal, Vertical or Custom. Fill Color and Opacity: Drag the slider to change the opacity and select the color of the text. Box Padding: Drag the slider to change the spacing between the text and the borders of the text box. Vertical Alignment: Select an alignment for the text.   Click Add to Gallery. Click Done.
Tip:When adding media to your gallery, you can also add Titles and Descriptions, Alt Text and Links to each gallery item.Choosing the position and titles of newly added mediaDecide where your newly added media is positioned in your gallery and how it's titled.To choose the position and titles of newly add media:
Click the Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Manage Media. Click the Settings for New Media icon . Select the checkbox next to your preferred position and title setting:
    
Where should new items go?: Choose to display new media at the start or end of the gallery. What title do new items have?: Decide whether newly added media has no title or retains the file name as its title.  FAQsClick an option below to learn more about adding media to your gallery.How can I delete the default media in the Pro Gallery?To delete the default media that comes with the gallery, hover over the item you want to delete, click the More Actions icon  and click Remove.How can I add media to my gallery if it's connected to the CMS?If your gallery is connected to the CMS (Content Management System), please follow these steps to add or update your media. Can I play multiple videos in my gallery at the same time?If you have more than one video in your Pro Gallery, only one video autoplays at a time. What is shown if I don't add a cover image to my YouTube video?If your YouTube video does not have a cover image, the gallery displays the default YouTube screen. Learn how to add a cover imageCan I embed playlists from YouTube or Vimeo in my gallery?It is not possible to embed playlist links from YouTube or Vimeo. You must add a specific link to an individual video.Can I control the quality of YouTube videos?YouTube automatically changes the quality of your video stream based on your / your site visitor's viewing conditions. These conditions are why you / they may notice that the quality of your video changes as you / they watch it. Learn more about the factors that determine video quality and how to change video quality on YouTubeHow can I change the order of my images, videos and text in the gallery?You can change the order of items in your gallery from the Organize Your Gallery window.

Learn how to reorder your gallery itemsCan I arrange gallery items by the date they were added?Currently, it is not possible to arrange your gallery items by the date they were added. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, you can vote for that feature. Can I randomize the order of my gallery items?Currently, it is not possible to randomize the order of your gallery items in a Pro Gallery. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, you can vote for that feature. Can I edit images in my gallery using the Wix Photo Studio?You can edit images added to your gallery using the Wix Photo Studio tools.To edit an image:
Click the Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Manage Media. Click the image you want to edit in the Organize Your Gallery window. Click the Edit Image icon  on the right. Edit the image using the Wix Photo Studio tools.

source_documents.title: Wix Restaurants: Setting Up Your Availability for Online Reservations
source_documents.content:
Wix Restaurants: Setting Up Your Availability for Online Reservations
The Wix Table Reservations app allows guests to book tables online according to your restaurant's availability. You decide the reservation schedule, including seating times, maximum party size, and special days that affect availability, with the option for manual approval.You can set rules based on guest numbers to ensure appropriate dining time and limit reservations to minimize crowding, adjusting availability for different party sizes.Note:Currently, updating your reservation schedule and special days are only available on desktop.To set your availability:DashboardWix app
Go to Table Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click Settings at the top right. Click Online reservations. Set the following availability details:Online availabilitySet the days and times when guests can book a table online under Online availability:
Click Edit to set the days and times of the First seating and Last seating. (Optional) Click + Add Special Day to add an event that affects your restaurant's availability. Click Apply.  Set the amount of time before the reservation start time that guests can book a table online under Minimum notice (minutes, hours, or days).
Party sizeChoose the number of guests that can be booked online.
Set the Min and Max number of guests that can be booked online under Party size. (Optional) Select the Display your phone number checkbox to have guests call your restaurant when booking reservations for larger party sizes. (Optional) Require your approval before specific online reservations are confirmed:
    
Enable the Require manual approval toggle Enter the party size that requires your approval.


  Turnover timeSet reservation time limits based on party size.
Click Edit under Turnover time. Click the Default duration drop-down and set the duration for all table reservations. (Optional) Click + Add Rule to add rules to the duration of the reservation based on the number of guests. For example, you may allow longer durations for bigger parties, and shorter durations for small ones. Click Apply.


Time slots and pacingSet the number of guests and parties that can arrive within the same time slot to avoid overloading your staff under Time Slots and Pacing:
Select the Maximum number of guests per time slot checkbox and set how many guests can arrive in the same 15 minute time frame. Select the Maximum number of parties per time slot checkbox and set how many parties can arrive in the same 15 minute time frame.
5.  Click Save.
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Table Reservations and select Table Reservations.  Tap the More Actions icon  at the top right. source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Connecting Printify to Your Store
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Connecting Printify to Your Store
Printify is a easy-to-use print on demand dropshipping app that allows you to sell custom-designed clothing, accessories, mugs, phone cases, and more. You can add your personal designs to products, and Printify makes sure it gets shipped to your customer! How it worksYou add your design to a Printify product, set your price, and add the product to your store.Only after a customer purchases the product, do you pay Printify. They then go ahead and create, package, and ship the goods to your customer. You don't have to worry about storing inventory or managing fulfillment. Printify costsThere are no upfront costs. You only pay when a customer places an order. Learn morePrintify product selectionPrintify offers more  250 products for you to choose from, including t-shirts, shoes, dresses, jewelry, wall decals, phone cases, and more.To connect Printify to your Wix Store:
Go to the Wix App Market in your Editor:
    
Wix Editor: Click Add Apps  on the left side of the Editor. Editor X: Click App Market  at the top of Editor X.   Start typing Printify in the search box and select it. Click +Add.  Click Allow and Install. Select an option:
    
Sign up to create a new Printify account Log in to an existing Printify account   (For new accounts) Follow the instructions in the email you received to confirm your email address. Go to the Printify dashboard.  Click the Profile icon  at the top right. Select My Account. Click My Stores. Click Add new store. Click Connect  next to Wix. If you have more than one Wix site, click Select next to the site you want to connect. Click Allow and Install. From the Select store that you want to connect to drop-down, select the Printify store you want to connect to your Wix site, and click Continue.
Tip: If you just created your Printify account, your default store in named "My new store".

source_documents.title: Wix Stores: Integrating with Envia
source_documents.content:
Wix Stores: Integrating with Envia
Important:To print shipping labels, you must first enter your business's address in the Business Info page. Learn howEnvia is a third-party app that integrates with Wix Stores so you can create domestic and international shipping labels with reliable couriers - all at a great price. Choose from a wide variety of shipping carriers, including:
FedEx DHL iVoy Redpack UPS Sendex Carssa Paquete Express 99 Minutos QuikenNotes:
Envia is currently available for stores located in the US, Mexico, Colombia, Spain, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Guatemala, Canada, India, and Australia. Envia is free to use. You pay only for the shipping labels you purchase. You can connect one Wix store to one Envia account. To integrate with Envia:
Click here to access the app. Click Add to Site. Click Agree & Add. Click Continue. Enter your email address and click Continue.
Note: You will be logged into your existing account or a new one will be created.  For new accounts: Fill in the required information and click Continue. Select an address from the Saved addresses drop-down or complete the fields to add a new one.
Click See Orders.After integration, new Wix store orders appear in the Envia dashboard every time you make a sale. In the Envia dashboard you can manage your shipments, printing labels and track orders.When a shipping label is created, the order in your Wix dashboard is updated so that the order status changes to "Fulfilled" and the tracking number is added.To learn more, check out the Envia help center.

source_documents.content:
ADI: Accessing Your Wix Bookings Pages
When you add Wix Bookings to your site, a new page is automatically added called Book Online. As part of the Wix Bookings app, 6 additional sub-pages / sections are added:
Services list: Customers can view and select services on this page. Service Page: Provide more information about the services you offer. Booking Calendar: Allow your customers and site visitors to book a service. Payment Info: Customers add their payment details.
